title: Systems Administrator
description:
About us:

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role:

The Systems Administrator manages the day-to-day operations of systems and solutions within CDC’s Corporate and Operational Technology environments. They ensure seamless integration and ongoing support while acting as the primary escalation point for Help Desk incidents.

Other Responsibilities Include:

  • Install, configure, and maintain software, hardware, networks, and technology tools.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure security through access controls, backups, and firewalls.
  • Manage network servers, workstations, and infrastructure, ensuring efficiency and reliability.
  • Implement upgrades, patches, and new releases while developing technical documentation and IT policies.
  • Train, mentor, and support staff in adopting new technologies and best practices.
  • Provide cultural leadership, champion IT policies, and take on additional duties as required.

About you:

This role is ideal for a candidate with proven experience in troubleshooting complex application and system issues at Levels 2 and 3. The incumbent should also have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, M365, Intune and VMWare. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals eager to learn, develop their skills, and advance their careers as our organisation continues to grow. Previous experience supporting Operational Technology Environments is a bonus!

  • Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Closing Date: 11.59pm Monday 3rd of August 2026

title: FBS AIOps Engineer
description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

Requirements

Summary:

The AIOps Engineer is a member of the centralized AIOps platform team responsible for designing, building, and operating a shared AIOps technology stack that supports IT Operations, SRE, and Infrastructure teams across the enterprise. This role partners closely with downstream operations teams to deliver actionable alerts, intelligent event correlation, and runbook automation, while ensuring the AIOps platform is scalable, reliable, and aligned to enterprise standards. Rather than embedding directly within a single operations team, the AIOps Engineer enables multiple teams through reusable patterns, platform capabilities, and AI driven insights.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain a centralized AIOps platform that ingests observability and operational data from multiple sources (metrics, logs, traces, events, tickets). • Build and maintain integrations with monitoring, ITSM, CI/CD, and cloud platforms.
  • Ensure platform scalability, resiliency, and performance for enterprise wide adoption.
  • Maintain standardized data models, entity definitions, and service mappings to support correlation and root cause analysis.
  • Actionable Alerting & Event Correlation • Partner with operations teams to define alerting requirements that focus on actionability and business impact, not signal volume.
  • Implement and tune event correlation capabilities to reduce alert noise and group related events across infrastructure and application layers.
  • Leverage topology, dependency mapping, and contextual enrichment to produce meaningful alerts aligned to services and customer experience.
  • Continuously evaluate alert effectiveness and adjust correlation logic based on operational feedback.
  • Enable runbook automation workflows that support incident response, investigation, and recovery.
  • Integrate alerts and correlated events with automated actions, enrichment steps, and remediation activities (with appropriate safeguards). • Support standardized incident workflows by integrating AIOps outcomes into ITSM tools and collaboration platforms.
  • Help operational teams transition manual responses into repeatable, automated runbooks over time.
  • Act as a consultative partner to operations, SRE, and platform teams. • Gather use cases, translate operational needs into AIOps solutions, and prioritize work within the centralized backlog.
  • Enable self service capabilities while maintaining governance and guardrails. • Provide guidance, documentation, and best practices to ensure consistent adoption across teams.
  • Monitor accuracy and effectiveness of AIOps features such as anomaly detection, correlation, and RCA.
  • Incorporate feedback loops from incident outcomes and operator input. • Ensure solutions align to enterprise standards for security, compliance, and AI governance.
  • Contribute to platform roadmaps, technical standards, and long term AIOps strategy

Skills & Tools:

  • Dynatrace - Intermediate (2-4 Years) MUST
  • Copilot Studio - Entry Level (1-2 Years) MUST
  • ITIL Foundations
  • Service Now – Desirable
  • Snowflake – Desirable
  • Python – Entry Level - Desirable

Benefits

This position comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • A competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based).
  • You will also enjoy a dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group.
  • Private Health Insurance.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Training & Development opportunities in partnership with renowned companies.

title: Director of Revenue
description:
Clients Blackbox is a specialized Meta advertising agency that works exclusively with Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and independent financial advisory firms. We build and manage Facebook advertising funnels that generate qualified, booked appointments for our clients. We serve one vertical and we do it at a level no generalist agency can match.

You will own both sales and marketing for the company. This is a hands on, individual contributor role where you run our sales process from first conversation to signed contract while also building and executing our internal marketing strategy.

On the sales side, you will take all introductory and discovery calls with inbound prospects, run strategy and pitch presentations, manage the full pipeline from first touch to close, handle objections, follow ups, proposals, and contract negotiations, and build and maintain a sales playbook, objection library, and follow up sequences.

On the marketing side, you will own and operate our internal Meta advertising campaigns, develop and execute our broader marketing strategy including content, brand positioning, and demand generation, elevate the company brand to attract larger and more established clients, and create or direct the creation of marketing assets such as ads, landing pages, case studies, and social content. You will think holistically about brand and understand how advertising fits within a larger growth strategy.

This role has a clear trajectory toward leading a sales and marketing function. As the company grows and you demonstrate results, there is an opportunity to build a team underneath you and evolve the role into a broader leadership position.

Compensation: $85,000 base salary plus performance based commission on closed business, paid quarterly. OTE is approximately $150,000 per year. Commission structure details will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process.

To apply, please include a brief Loom video (3 to 5 minutes) covering: who you are and why this role interests you, a deal you personally closed that you are proud of and how you ran the process, and one observation about our current marketing after reviewing our website and social media presence. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Clients Blackbox is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of B2B closing experience (not appointment setting or lead qualification only)
  2. Demonstrated track record of earning $125,000 or more in total compensation in a previous role, with a meaningful portion from commissions or performance based incentives
  3. Experience selling professional services with a sales cycle of approximately 2 to 6 weeks to SMB or mid market buyers
  4. Hands on experience running paid media campaigns (Meta preferred) or strong working knowledge of direct response and digital marketing
  5. Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) including pipeline management, deal tracking, and reporting
  6. Comfortable operating as a sole contributor across both sales and marketing functions
  7. Strong written and verbal communication skills
  8. Based in the United States and available during standard business hours
  9. Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

Benefits

  1. $85,000 base salary plus performance based commission (OTE approximately $150,000)
  1. Fully remote position
  2. Opportunity to build and lead a sales and marketing team as the company grows
  3. Work directly with the CEO and founding team
  4. Focused, single vertical niche with strong product market fit

title: Hybrid Senior Associate Level Privacy Law
description:
Hybrid Law Firm Senior Associate Privacy

Salary Range of 150K-210K Plus Yearly Bonus Offered
Excellent compensation package plus benefits
Bethesda, MD


A nationally recognized law firm is seeking a seasoned Privacy and Data Protection Partner to help expand a rapidly growing Privacy and Data Protection Practice. This strategic hire will support increasing client demand and strengthen the team’s ability to counsel sophisticated clients on complex and evolving data privacy issues.

About the Role:
The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience advising clients on U.S. and international privacy laws and frameworks, providing practical and forward-thinking legal guidance on compliance, risk management, incident response, and strategic data use. You’ll serve clients across industries such as technology, healthcare, education, media, retail, and financial services.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with other senior attorneys and practice leaders, mentor junior lawyers, contribute to thought leadership, and play a key role in expanding one of the firm’s fastest-growing practices.

Why Join:

This opportunity offers a national platform and entrepreneurial environment where experienced attorneys can lead and grow. The Privacy and Data Protection team is collaborative and interdisciplinary, working closely with practices across corporate, employment, healthcare, and IP law. Attorneys are supported by strong administrative resources, a national footprint, and firm-wide investment in privacy as a strategic area of growth.

Requirements

  • Deep subject matter expertise in domestic and global privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, GLBA, FERPA, and others)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead client relationships and provide strategic advice on privacy compliance, operational implementation, and risk mitigation
  • Experience supporting incident response, breach notification, and regulatory investigations
  • Familiarity with privacy due diligence and data-related concerns in M&A and commercial transactions
  • Strong skills in drafting and negotiating data protection agreements, vendor and customer contracts, and privacy schedules
  • A client-first mindset, strong judgment, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach
  • A portable book of business is welcomed but not required

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts and commuter benefits
  • Generous vacation and sick leave
  • Paid holidays, parental leave, fertility benefits, and backup care support

title: Product Manager
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
description:
We are making the future of Mobility come to life starting today.

At Autofleet we support the world’s largest vehicle fleet operators and transportation providers to optimize existing operations and seamlessly launch new, dynamic business models - driving efficient operations and maximizing utilization.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our product team and guide products from conception to launch.

Product development at Autofleet is an extremely collaborative effort between engineering, design, and business teams. In your day-to-day you will define product requirements based on a deep understanding of our clients’ mobility operations and work closely with R&D during the development and release cycle. You’ll meet with customers and remain in close contact with the operations and business teams, keeping an ear to the ground of developing trends.

Things here move quickly, so you’ll need the ability to think on your feet, breaking down complex problems into steps that drive product development at high velocity.


What you’ll do:

  • Play a key role at every stage of the product life cycle, from planning the roadmap, defining needs and writings PRDs, to working closely with the R&D team and managing releases to production
  • Meet with clients to make sure that our goals are aligned with their needs
  • Conduct industry research, defining problems and needs and discovering new opportunities
  • Build wireframes and work closely with our designers, making sure that our products have top-notch usability, meet requirements and look great
  • Manage the QA and release process of features
  • Monitor the adoption of new functionality and measure against the defined KPIs
  • Proactively communicate project status, issues and risks to the business team
  • Keep in close contact with our clients, making sure that we continue to deliver value, enhance our products, and learn from our clients’ experience.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience in building SaaS B2B products
  • A solid technical understanding of web technologies and SaaS architectures and how these impact development time and releases
  • Experience working with B2B customers and extracting needs and requirements and translating these into scalable product features
  • You possess ownership abilities and entrepreneurial qualities. You’re self-driven and feel comfortable motivating, leading, and making decisions without consensus
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, agile work environment where needs can change quickly. You’re comfortable making quick changes to plans and pushing products to production that have an immediate impact on users around the globe
  • Be the best multi-tasker you know, managing many projects in parallel
  • Bachelor Degree in a technical field is preferred
  • Fantastic spoken and written English
  • Bonus: Knowledge of SQL, JavaScript, Python or other coding languages

Location: United States (Remote); candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without future sponsorship requirements

Travel: Approximately 50%, primarily for donor meetings and events across the U.S., with occasional international travel

Salary: $160,000–$190,000 with comprehensive benefits and generous PTO

One Pratham

Pratham is committed to helping build future-ready schools and communities where every child, youth, and woman has the education, skills, and opportunities to thrive in an ever-changing world.

Founded in India in 1995, Pratham is one of the world's leading education nonprofits, known for its award-winning, evidence-based approaches to improving learning outcomes. Working in partnership with governments, communities, parents, teachers, and volunteers, Pratham develops and scales innovative solutions that address some of the most pressing challenges in the learning landscape worldwide.

Today, Pratham's work reaches millions of children and young people annually across India and is being adapted in 30 countries across Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America, the Middle East and North Africa, and Southeast Asia.

Pratham USA

Pratham USA is part of the global Pratham network and serves as the organization's fundraising and engagement arm in the United States. Through 14 chapters and a nationwide community of donors, volunteers, corporate partners, and advocates, Pratham USA raises awareness and mobilizes resources to support Pratham's mission and impact globally.

Together, Pratham's global network is working to ensure that children, young people, girls, and women have the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive in an ever-changing world. For more information about Pratham USA, visit prathamusa.org

Pratham’s Focus

Children & Learning: Engages children ages 3–14 to improve their basic reading and math skills.

Youth & Skilling: Promotes economic self-sufficiency for young adults through training and job placement.

Girls & Women’s Empowerment: Assists female dropouts over the age of 14 in completing their secondary school education and earning their 10th-grade diploma.

Research & Advocacy Efforts: Measures and provides reliable data on children’s learning.

Digital Solutions: AI offers a way to reimagine learning for students who lack access to high-quality educational resources. Pratham’s innovation enables children to verify and deepen their knowledge beyond textbooks while strengthening teacher effectiveness at scale.

The Role

Pratham USA is looking for a strategic and relationship-driven Director of Principal Gifts to play a critical role in growing philanthropic support from high-net-worth individuals and families across the United States and beyond. Reporting to the CEO, the Director will build on Pratham’s existing work by establishing and managing a portfolio of principal donors and prospects, developing tailored donor engagement and stewardship strategies, and securing significant philanthropic investments that advance Pratham’s mission. Over time, the role will also have the opportunity to explore other strategic growth initiatives.

With oversight of a small team, the Director will focus on cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding donors with the capacity to make gifts of $100,000 and above. Working closely with the CEO, National Board members, chapters, volunteer fundraisers, and others, the Director will identify and advance new opportunities, build a strong pipeline of principal gift prospects, and develop compelling funding opportunities and products. The Director will also help strengthen Pratham’s capacity to effectively engage and steward more principal-level donors and support the successful closure of six- and seven-figure gifts.

While the initial focus will be on expanding principal-level philanthropy and fundraising initiatives across the United States, over time, the role may also support the development of fundraising capacity and strategic growth opportunities across Pratham’s global fundraising network.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled relationship builder with a proven track record of securing transformational gifts, navigating complex donor relationships, and working effectively with executive leaders and influential volunteers. They will also be a strategic thinker, team player, and organization builder who can help Pratham at this critical stage of its evolution.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape the future of one of the world’s most impactful education organizations while building meaningful relationships with donors committed to creating lasting social change.

Requirements

Impact Areas

Major Gifts Portfolio Management

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of major donors and prospects with giving capacity of $100,000+.
  • Develop individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans that strengthen relationships and increase philanthropic investment.
  • Conduct donor visits, qualification meetings, and ongoing engagement activities to advance prospects through the donor pipeline.
  • Maintain strategic moves management plans and ensure accurate tracking of donor activity and progress.

Principal Gifts and Transformational Giving

  • Partner closely with the CEO and Leadership Team to develop and execute strategies for principal gift prospects.
  • Support the cultivation and solicitation of donors capable of making six- and seven-figure commitments, adding at least 5–7 new $100,000+ donors each year, with an expectation of securing a transformational gift of $1 million+ every two years. Specific targets will be established together by the Director, CEO, and National Board of Directors.
  • Build a pipeline capable of generating sustainable six- and seven-figure philanthropic commitments over multiple years.
  • Develop compelling funding opportunities, donor presentations, and proposals aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Coordinate donor briefings, strategy sessions, and stewardship plans for gifts of $1 million and above.

Volunteer and Leadership Partnership

  • Leverage the National Board, volunteer networks, and community relationships to expand Pratham’s donor pipeline and steward major gift prospects in close collaboration with the Pratham USA Leadership Team.
  • Prepare volunteers and organizational leaders for donor meetings, solicitations, and stewardship activities.
  • Strengthen engagement among key stakeholders who play a role in fundraising success.

Strategic Donor Engagement

  • Design and execute personalized donor engagement and stewardship strategies that deepen relationships, strengthen donor retention, and increase long-term philanthropic commitment.
  • Lead the continued development and evolution of Pratham’s LEADers Circle, including its value proposition, engagement strategy, stewardship approach, recognition benefits, and opportunities for deeper donor involvement.
  • Develop and oversee a comprehensive donor recognition and stewardship program that ensures donors are acknowledged consistently and meaningfully.
  • Build and implement Pratham USA’s planned giving strategy and program, including the development of a qualified prospect pipeline, donor education and outreach, marketing materials, internal processes, and long-term stewardship plans.
  • Develop a strategic framework for naming opportunities and other major donor funding products, working with program, finance, legal, and leadership colleagues to ensure opportunities are compelling, appropriately valued, and aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Support cultivation events, chapter gatherings, donor briefings, and other stewardship opportunities that strengthen donor relationships and enhance the overall donor experience.
  • Identify opportunities to align donor interests and philanthropic goals with Pratham’s programs, strategic priorities, and funding needs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to donors and prospects throughout the cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship lifecycle.

Fundraising Strategy and Organizational Collaboration

  • Partner with the CEO and colleagues across philanthropy, marketing, communications, and programs to advance fundraising priorities, as well as identify new opportunities for strategic growth, including strategic investment in and growth of Pratham fundraising entities outside of the United States.
  • Partner and collaborate effectively with all members of the Pratham USA Leadership Team to identify critical organizational capacities needed for more effective donor stewardship, as well as opportunities for strategic growth.
  • Utilize donor insights, fundraising metrics, and portfolio performance data to inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Contribute to revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and annual fundraising planning.
  • Serve as an ambassador for Pratham USA, effectively communicating the organization’s mission, impact, and vision to donors and stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 12–15 years of fundraising experience, including responsibility for developing and managing relationships with major and principal donors.
  • Demonstrated success in securing gifts of $100,000+ and building relationships with high-net-worth donors.
  • Demonstrated experience developing fundraising strategy and building or scaling major and principal gift programs.
  • Experience managing donor portfolios and advancing prospects through the cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship cycle.
  • Experience partnering with executive leaders, board members, peers, and volunteers to achieve fundraising goals.
  • Ability to travel nationally and potentially internationally for donor meetings and events.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong major gifts fundraising and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate results directly and independently, while also coaching and leveraging a small direct and matrixed team.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication abilities.
  • Ability to engage and influence donors, volunteers, and community leaders.
  • Strategic thinker with strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively with peers, team members, and volunteers.
  • Experience developing donor strategies, proposals, and stewardship plans.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, emotional intelligence, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Passion for Pratham’s mission and commitment to educational opportunity and social impact.
  • Experience working within international nonprofits, global organizations, or cross-border philanthropy is strongly preferred. Familiarity with India or South Asia is an advantage but not required.

Benefits

Application Process

For questions or accommodation needs during the application process, please contact Mariya Yurukova at mariya@charitysearchgroup.com or visit.

Pratham USA is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, veterans, and individuals from historically underrepresented communities.

title: FBS Distribution Hub Leader.
description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

What to expect on your journey with us:

  • A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
  • A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
  • Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
  • Continuous learning and development

The Distribution Hub Leader is responsible for contributing to business strategy, integrating into the BU senior leadership team, leading initiatives at a senior level, measuring and exceeding key performance outcomes, tracking plans vs. actuals and roadmap planning and mitigating issues at an early stage. This position focuses on enhancing collaboration, process improvement, and skill development within specific functions across Farmers’ Lines of Business (LOBs). This senior role proves subject matter expertise, identifying skill gaps, facilitating mentorship, conducting performance reviews, and promoting knowledge-sharing among team members. Business Hub Leaders play a key role in recruiting, assessing and hiring top talent and ensuring new hires integrate smoothly into the team, while empowering members to make decisions within their delegated authority. Distribution Hub Leaders interact closely with HR Business Partners to create job descriptions and understand demand.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Strategy Implementation and execution: As a Senior Leader and member of the Line of Business Leadership Team, this role is responsible for participating and implementing the LOB business strategy.
  • Subject-Matter Expertise: Provide subject matter expertise to Farmers LOBs in their functional area, staying up to date with best practices, technologies, and market trends.
  • Data Analytics Strategy: Develop and implement data analytics strategies to improve operational efficiency, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Operational Strategy: Leverage technology to improve operational efficiency, improve prospect quality, and increase gross written premium for Farmers and Farmers Agents.
  • Domain Expertise and Talent Development: Prioritize domain expertise and knowledge-sharing within their craft, ensuring consistency and best practices across organization, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous improvement, and establishing clear career paths and development plans for team members.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Promote knowledge sharing and exchange within team members, ensuring best practices are shared and implemented across different areas and departments.
  • Skill Development and Mentorship: Identify skill development needs, areas of improvement, and skill gaps within team members, and facilitate mentorship and learning opportunities to improve their skills.
  • Performance Management: Lead by example, conduct performance reviews in partnership with Farmers managers, provide constructive feedback, and help hub members grow their careers.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Foster collaboration and communication between members of different departments within their allocated teams.
  • Recruitment: Act as a “talent magnet” in the markets, universities, and internally. Hub Leaders play a critical role in recruiting for positions within their job families and areas of expertise, assessing technical and domain-specific skills.
  • Integration of New Hires: Ensure that new hires are seamlessly integrated into the team and culture.
  • Empowerment: Empower team members to self-organize and make decisions within specific delegation of authority.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in senior leadership roles, preferably within a similar industry.
  • Strong domain-specific skills relevant to the Business Unit.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, assess, and hire top talent.
  • Experience in leading initiatives and assignments at a senior level.
  • Ability to contribute meaningfully to business strategies and roadmap planning.
  • Strong performance management skills, including conducting performance reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to foster a culture of high performance and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Proven track record of integrating new hires and building strong team cultures.
  • Ability to empower team members and delegate authority effectively.
  • Insurance (P&C/Personal Lines) background experience is required
  • Fluent in English

Benefits

This position comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  1. A competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  2. Comprehensive benefits package.
  3. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based).
  4. You will also enjoy a dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group.
  5. Private Health Insurance.
  6. Paid Time Off.
  7. Training & Development opportunities in partnership with renowned companies.

• Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.

• Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.

• Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

title: Associate Grocery Food Buyer
location: College Point, New York, United States
description:
Associate Grocery Food Buyer **Must Be a Current Food Buyer**

Salary: $85,000–$90,000 plus bonus and benefits

Location: On-site at our corporate office in College Point, NY

Our food company is seeking an Associate Grocery Food Buyer responsible for the profitable procurement and timely delivery of frozen food products for assigned lines. This role works closely with the Senior Vice President of Purchasing to achieve company goals. The Associate Frozen Food Buyer provides supply chain and inventory management for promotionally active categories while meeting corresponding financial accountabilities. Products are procured in accordance with all company policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Order food products to meet forecasted demand.
  • Secure the best possible product costs, quality, and service at all times.
  • Ensure all established policies and procedures are understood and followed.
  • Achieve inventory and turn goals while maintaining service levels and minimizing distress.
  • Interface with various departments and division personnel to accomplish job functions.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with vendors, store operations, the distribution center, and division office personnel.
  • Review acquisition costs to ensure purchases are made at the lowest cost consistent with quality, reliability, and urgency.
  • Assess current inventory, market conditions, availability, and promotional impact to forecast order quantities and make recommendations to the merchandising team.
  • Conduct post-promotional reviews to evaluate results and develop solutions for improvement.
  • Resolve store-level inventory issues caused by allocations or order discrepancies.
  • Review and analyze daily and weekly reports to monitor costs, quality, service levels, inventory turns, and distress, making adjustments as needed.
  • Visit stores, as required, to monitor programs, gather feedback, and assess implementation effectiveness.
  • Manage Accounts Payable variance processes for distribution-sourced items to ensure correct invoicing.
  • Resolve store billing questions by researching discrepancies, issuing credits, or providing appropriate resolutions.
  • Maintain all necessary department files and records.
  • Coordinate with Warehouse Operations to maintain proper product flow through the facility in a timely manner.
  • Access buying systems remotely when necessary to manage responsibilities offsite.

Requirements

  • Marketing/Logistics experience preferred or strong understanding of store operations and merchandising methodologies and practices.
  • Understanding of grocery procurement, logistics, inventory management, marketing, accounting and financial management practices
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills; ability to take initiative and make fact- based decisions.
  • Ability to plan and organize effectively.
  • Written and verbal communication skills as well as interpersonal skills to develop and maintain effective business relationships both internally and externally.
  • Strong computer aptitude in MS Office including Word and Excel.
  • Ability to concentrate and deal with frequent interruptions.

Benefits

$85,000–$90,000 plus bonus and benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development

title: Technical Product Manager / Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Assurity Trusted Solutions (ATS) is committed to providing secure and reliable digital identity services and solutions as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Government Technology Agency (GovTech). Our goal is to be the leading Source of Trust in the digital landscape, thereby enhancing Trust and High Assurance in the use of digital services.

Role Overview:

As a Technical Product Manager (TPM), you will own one or more digital products within the Port, Shipping or Corporate domains. You are accountable for product outcomes across the full lifecycle — from problem definition and roadmap planning to delivery, adoption, operations and continuous improvement.

This is a product ownership role, not a project coordination role. You will make informed product and technical trade-offs, working closely with business owners, users, engineers, architects, infrastructure teams and vendors.

For senior hires, the role includes owning broader product areas, mentoring other product managers and shaping product practices across Digital Enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define product vision, outcomes and roadmap aligned with business and industry needs
  • Engage internal users and external industry stakeholders to identify problems and priorities
  • Translate needs into clear functional and technical requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Prioritise product backlog based on value, risk and technical constraints
  • Guide iterative delivery and releases with engineering teams and vendors
  • Own products post go-live, including adoption, stability and continuous improvement
  • Analyse issues, drive root cause analysis and prioritise improvements

Technical & Architecture Responsibilities:

  • Provide strong technical product leadership, including evaluating solution options and trade-offs
  • Where required, act as the product’s solution architect, defining high-level architecture, integration approach, data flows and non-functional requirements
  • Where a dedicated architect exists, partner closely to drive coherent technical decisions

Role Clarity:

  • Owns product outcomes, not just delivery activity
  • Not a pure project manager role
  • May perform architecture responsibilities depending on product complexity and team setup
  • Does not replace engineering teams, but ensures technical decisions align to product goals
  • Includes accountability after go-live

Requirements

Technical Product Manager

  • 3+ years’ experience in product management, digital solution ownership, business analysis or similar roles
  • Strong technical foundation (architecture, integration, data, security fundamentals)
  • Experience working with Agile or iterative delivery teams
  • Strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences

Senior Technical Product Manager (Additional)

  • Experience owning complex or multiple digital products
  • Ability to act as product architect or solution lead when required
  • Experience mentoring other product managers and influencing product practices

Good to Have

  • Background as a software engineer, solution architect or technical lead
  • Experience with external-facing digital products for customers or industry partners
  • Familiarity with public sector governance or vendor delivery environments

Join us and discover a meaningful and exciting career with Assurity Trusted Solutions!

title: Expression of Interest: Senior Layout Artist (Featurette)
description:
OUR STORY


For more than 35 years, Bardel Entertainment has been growing and evolving, yet at our core, we remain grounded in the creative roots of the craft of animation. Our pursuit of fresh ideas, techniques, and technologies is driven by the belief that together, through creativity and collaboration, we can accomplish anything! If you want to be part of an environment that empowers you to experiment, learn, and contribute to exciting projects, come and join us.

What You’ll Do

  • Establish the staging and camera positioning of scenes in a CG environment.
  • Collaborate with the Layout Supervisor to align cinematography with the director’s vision.
  • Interpret storyboards into 3D, offering solutions and pitching new ideas to enhance the visual story.
  • Identify potential storytelling, staging, or technical issues early and propose effective solutions.
  • Take ownership of challenging shots and sequences, working independently while knowing when to seek direction.
  • Animate elements and characters for framing and story beats.
  • Collaborate with leadership, production, and team members to solve problems and share insights.
  • Engage in dailies, rounds, and team discussions to contribute to creative and technical improvements.
  • Adhere to pipeline workflows and technical requirements for seamless integration into the production process.
  • Serve as a resource for other Layout Artists, sharing knowledge, techniques, and best practices.
  • Maintain consistency in quality while meeting production needs.
  • Manage time effectively, working with production to stay on schedule.
  • Keep the team and production staff informed about progress, challenges, and solutions.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring

  • Previous production experience as a Senior Layout Artist (or similar) in featurette/feature (long-form) animation.

title: ITSM Analyst
description:
Life @ AP+:

We are one connected team in pursuit of one inspiring purpose – to unite people and technology to power better experiences. Each of us has a part to play in making that happen. You’ll be encouraged to bring your big ideas forward and make a difference through your work. Taking steps forward in your career whilst still having room for fun, friendships, and flexibility in your daily life.

We’re driven by our core values: lead with heart, learn for tomorrow and live our legacy. A purpose like ours takes the inspired impact of an incredible team. Ready to change the game? We’re ready to help you do it.

The Purpose:

Find the cause. Improve the process. Make our services stronger.

As our IT Service Management Analyst, you’ll play an important role in keeping AP+ technology services stable, reliable and performing at their best.

You’ll work across Incident, Problem and Change Management, helping teams respond when things go wrong – but just as importantly, looking beyond the immediate fix to understand root causes, identify patterns and prevent issues from happening again.

You’ll monitor service performance, investigate recurring and high-impact issues, coordinate actions across technology teams and help ensure changes are introduced in a controlled way.

This is a role for someone who loves connecting the dots between technology, process, data and people – and turning those insights into better service outcomes.

The goal? Restore faster. Solve the underlying problem. Reduce risk. Keep improving.

Key Responsibilities the Role Owns:

  • Get to the root of problems – drive proactive and reactive Problem Management, investigating recurring and high-impact incidents and ensuring fixes and preventative actions are followed through.
  • Help restore services quickly – support Incident Management from prioritisation and diagnosis through escalation, recovery and closure, while identifying opportunities to improve how incidents are managed.
  • Keep change controlled and considered – govern Change Management activities, helping ensure changes are assessed, coordinated and aligned to AP+’s Change Enablement practices.
  • Turn service performance into action – monitor service delivery and performance data, identify issues and trends, and work with teams to maintain and improve service outcomes.
  • Keep teams focused on service commitments – monitor performance against service levels, maintain accurate service information and drive actions where performance needs attention.
  • Make ITSM better, not just busier – contribute to improving service management practices, processes and service catalogue information, helping create simpler and more effective ways of working across Technology.

You’ll likely be a strong fit for this role if:

You’re someone who doesn’t stop at “the incident is resolved.”

You want to understand why it happened, whether it could happen again and what needs to change to make the service stronger.

You’re comfortable working across multiple technology teams, bringing structure to operational issues and keeping actions moving. You can work within established processes without being afraid to challenge them when there’s a better way.

You’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience across Incident, Problem and Change Management, with a good understanding of how these practices work together to improve service reliability.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate incidents, identify root causes, patterns and recurring issues, and help drive preventative action.
  • Experience working within a technology operations, service management, service desk or similarly complex IT environment.
  • An understanding of service levels and performance monitoring, with the ability to use service data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Experience working with service management processes and service catalogues, maintaining accurate information and helping improve the experience for teams and customers.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills – you can bring the right people together, keep actions moving and translate operational or technical issues into clear service impacts and next steps.

More than anything, you’ll bring a continuous improvement mindset. You’ll be curious about how services operate today and motivated to make them more stable, resilient and effective tomorrow.

What happens next:

At AP+, we believe in the power of passion, pride and purpose. Our team is driven by a shared mission to make a difference in the world of payments, and we're proud to work together towards this common goal.

If you’re an IT Service Management professional who loves solving problems, improving services and making technology more reliable, we’d love to hear from you.

If you’re ready to be a game changer, please submit your application. The Talent Acquisition team will endeavour to review your application and notify you of the outcome within the next two weeks.

We want to remove all barriers to inclusion, so if you need advice or support with your application, we’re here to help. Please reach out to recruitment@auspayplus.com.au. We also encourage you to let us know your pronouns at any point during the recruitment process.

AP+ are not partnering with Recruitment agencies for this role.

Nuolat ieškodami plėtros galimybių ir augindami verslą, vadovaujamės strateginėmis gairėmis: investuojame į ateitį, tikime tvarumu ir dirbame išmaniai. UAB

Šiuo metu prie savo komandos kviečia prisijungti automechaniką (-ę) Kaune, kuris (-i) atliks automobilių techninio aptarnavimo ir remonto darbus.

Iš kandidato (-ės) mes tikimės:

  • Analogiško darbo patirties, atliekant automobilių techninio aptarnavimo/remonto darbus
  • Automobilio konstrukcijos išmanymo
  • Domėjimosi automobilių remonto technologijomis
  • Gebėjimo identifikuoti problemą ir pasiūlyti geriausią sprendimo metodą
  • Anglų kalbos pagrindų (rusų kalba - privalumas)
  • B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimo
  • Savarankiškumo, atidumo detalėms bei orientacijos į rezultatą

Benefits

Ko galite tikėtis prisijungus prie mūsų komandos:

  • Karjeros galimybių visoje įmonių grupėje
  • Įmonės partnerių siūlomų nuolaidų

Nuo 1100 - 2200 €/mėn. į rankas. Atlygį sudaro fiksuota bazinė dalis ir kintama dalis, tiesiogiai priklausanti nuo rezultatų.

title: Community Engagement Officer
description:
Carefound Home Care has developed a reputation as the highest quality provider of home care services to older people and we are rated Outstanding by the Care Quality Commission (CQC) across our branches. Join us, and you'll be part of a supportive, award-winning team which is centred around providing the best possible care and support to our clients and staff.

As Community Engagement Officer in York, you'll be responsible for raising awareness of Carefound Home Care in local communities, building relationships with partner organisations, and supporting client growth and staff recruitment through engaging local networking and marketing activity. The role is focused on community-based engagement and digital communications to ensure our services are well promoted, understood, and accessible. You'll help strengthen our reputation as an outstanding care provider, ensuring our values and brand are visible across the local area.

Benefits

  • Join the leading care team - rated Outstanding by the CQC across our branches
  • Competitive salary of up to £28,000 (depending on experience)
  • Benefits including 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, pension, and opportunities for career development

Responsibilities

  • Develop relationships in the local community maintaining a pipeline of opportunities by growing and leveraging your network
  • Networking face to face, by phone, email, video call with local groups, charities, healthcare professionals, community organisations, and any other potential referral providers
  • Deliver promotional activities both face to face and virtually to increase awareness of our care services and job opportunities in the local community
  • Build relationships with key referral providers, working to agreed targets and have regular touch points to drive client enquiries and job applications
  • Plan and successfully execute regular community marketing events including attending fairs, exhibitions, recruitment events and other events that would promote our services
  • Work with the central marketing team to plan and coordinate activity across social media platforms and ensure digital content is engaging and kept up to date
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of our brand and raise awareness of our central marketing campaigns and recruitment initiatives across the local community
  • Accurately track and record communications in the CRM and use the information to manage and adjust strategy to optimise messaging and education in the community
  • Work flexibly alongside branch care management team to support delivery of an outstanding care service

Requirements

  • Proven track record in successfully building strong relationships both face to face and virtually within a local community
  • Previous experience working in a home care or regulated service environment desirable
  • Confident to network face to face, by phone, email, video call with community stakeholders and potential referral providers
  • Confident to deliver presentations on key ageing subjects such as dementia
  • Good understanding of marketing principles with experience of using a range of marketing and communication approaches including digital media platforms
  • Proficiency in Microsoft, CRM and other marketing software, with the ability to learn and adopt new technologies where appropriate
  • Excellent communication, planning and organisational skills
  • Warm, patient and compassionate but also emotionally resilient and calm under pressure
  • Enthusiastic and positive 'can do' attitude
  • Commitment to providing and maintaining high standards of care and support
  • A valid driving licence and your own car

If you’d like to find out more about becoming a Community Engagement Officer in York, apply today. We can’t wait to hear from you.

Salary: Up to £28,000 per year

title: Traditional 2D Animator (Hand drawn)
description:
OUR STORY


For more than 35 years, Bardel Entertainment has been growing and evolving, yet at our core, we remain grounded in the creative roots of the craft of animation. Our pursuit of fresh ideas, techniques, and technologies is driven by the belief that together, through creativity and collaboration, we can accomplish anything! If you want to be part of an environment that empowers you to experiment, learn, and contribute to exciting projects, come and join us.

As a 2D Animator, you will create traditional character and prop animation that supports the style, performance, and production needs of the show. You will work closely with leads, supervisors, directors, and production to deliver polished animation while responding to creative and technical feedback.

What You’ll Do:

  • Animate 2D characters and props using traditional animation, ensuring shots align with the project’s artistic vision, quality standards, and production needs.
  • Revise animation based on feedback from leads, supervisors, and directors while handling shots of varying complexity and maintaining consistent quality.
  • Manage time effectively and work with production to stay on schedule.
  • Keep leads, production, and team members informed about progress, challenges, and solutions.
  • Participate in dailies, rounds, and team discussions, contributing ideas and feedback to support creative and technical improvements.
  • Adhere to pipeline workflows and technical requirements for seamless integration into the production process.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • Previous production experience as a 2D Animator on a feature or TV series, creating traditional animation.
  • At least 2 years of experience working with Toonboom Harmony 21 to Harmony 25 and excellent knowledge of all drawing and animation tools in Harmony.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively promote solutions, share knowledge, and incorporate feedback.
  • A portfolio or demo reel that demonstrates strong traditional 2D animation, including character performance, timing, spacing, and polish.
  • Strong drawing and draftsmanship skills, with an understanding of anatomy, posing, and perspective.
  • Strong character acting skills, including comedy, subtle expressions, and dynamic movement.

Benefits

Pay Range: CAD $1500 - $1700 per week

This salary range reflects our current expectations for these roles as of this posting’s date. Your final salary offer will consider various key factors, including your education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographical location, as well as the needs and requirements of the business.

Flexible work environment, Extended Health and Wellness from day 1, RRSP matching are just some of the benefits. For more details, check out our website.

At Bardel, we recognize that flexibility is key to doing great work. Our hybrid work environment is a valued perk designed to support individual accountability and empower our teams to work where they’re most productive. We offer the choice to work remotely, balanced with intentional in-person time for collaboration, creativity, and team building. This role requires in-studio attendance at our Vancouver studio during onboarding and predetermined Rush Weeks.

If this seems like a good fit, what are you waiting for, get your application in!

title: Workplace Ambassador and Errand Runner
description:
About Circles Culture:
The Circles culture is an inclusive environment that encourages self-expression and individuality. Creating a space for open communication, respect and job development empowers our employees to pursue their career goals and advance personally and professionally. Circles prioritizes the wellbeing of our employees so that our consumers experience that same level of care.

Position Overview:
The role of the Workplace Ambassador and Errand Runner is to offer white glove customer service while also displaying a professional and enthusiastic personality to on-site employees at our clients' location. Your main responsibility will be to assist our clientele with local errand running within specified parameters and criteria. You will also represent Circles by building meaningful relationships with members and educating them about their Circles Concierge benefits! Qualified candidates will have excellent customer service skills, a warm and friendly demeanor, exceptional attention to detail and be highly organized. Our ideal candidate will be an ambassador for their local area, possessing a curated knowledge of local businesses, entertainment venues, local events and highlights and dining options. Experience in the hotel, hospitality or the travel industry is strongly preferred.

This is a full-time position offering 34 hours per week. Schedule is Monday through Thursday from 8:00am to 5:00pm

Enjoy a schedule with no nights and a three-day weekend!

Compensation is hourly based on experience, from $27-$28 per.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Local Errand Running;
  • Promote Circles services and benefits to members;
  • Participate in various onsite events that highlight the program;
  • Coordinating and scheduling services with local and national partners and vendors;
  • Consistently provide best in class customer service in a fast paced, structured environment;
  • Prioritizing requests and monitoring daily deliverables;
  • Provide uncompromising service to members;
  • Project an approachable and professional image always;
  • Promote meaningful relationships via face-to-face interaction with members, vendors and peers;
  • Respond to members and guests in a professional, courteous, and timely manner, without exception;
  • Collaborate on innovative ideas and initiatives with management;
  • Suggest and purchase gifts and flowers; recommend tickets and dining; make reservations and schedule services;
  • Provide Notary Public Services as needed;
  • Manage on-site convenience services; such as onsite auto-detailing, dry-cleaning, bike tune-ups, etc
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

    • Strong knowledge and familiarity with navigating the local area
    • Candidates must be eligible to become a notary public
    • Comfortable with a high volume of driving to complete errands;
    • Customer Service experience within the Hospitality field preferred;
    • Must have reliable transportation;
    • Must have clean driving record;
    • Must be able to lift 40lbs;
    • High school diploma or GED required;
    • Must have excellent digital literacy and knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Teams, Outlook, Word);
    • Knowledge of Salesforce a plus!

Competencies:

    • Manage and prioritize multiple tasks daily;
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
    • Ability to adhere to a schedule;
    • Active listening;
    • Desire for continuous learning and development;
    • Flexibility to adapt to changing tasks and priorities

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance starting the first day of the month after hire
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance paid for by Circles
  • 401k with match
  • Life insurance paid for by Circles
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Paid holidays
  • One paid day off per year to volunteer
  • Access to discount programs
  • Four-week paid sabbatical every five years
  • HSA/FSA account eligibility
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program
  • Access to Employee Benefit Resource Groups that provide ongoing learning and mentorship opportunities

title: Senior Beverage Buyer
location: Great Neck, New York, United States
description:
Senior Beverage Buyer

Salary 100K plus bonus and benefits.

Working onsite at our corporate office in Great Neck, NY.

Food and beverage company is responsible for the profitable procurement and timely delivery of products for assigned lines. Works closely with the Sr. Director of Purchasing and Senior Buyers to achieve the goals of the company. Provides supply chain/inventory management for promotionally active categories and corresponding financial accountabilities. Procures products in accordance with all policies and procedures established by the company.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Order products to meet forecasted demand.
  • Obtain the best possible product costs, quality, and service at all times.
  • Ensure that established policies and procedures are understood and adhered to.
  • Strive to obtain inventory and turn goals, while maintaining service level and minimizing distress.

* Interface with various departments and division personnel to accomplish job functions. Develop and maintain good working relationships with vendors, store operations, distribution center, and division office personnel.

  • Review acquisition costs to ensure items purchased are at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source, and urgency of need.
  • Assess current inventory, market conditions, availability, and promotional impact to forecast order quantities and make recommendations to the merchandising team.
  • Conduct post-promotional reviews and analyses to determine if promotional requirements were met and develop solutions for problem areas.
  • Review and resolve inventory issues at the store level as a result of allocations or order issues. * Review and analyze daily and weekly reports to monitor costs, quality, service level, inventory turns, and distress and make adjustments as needed.
  • Visit stores, as needed, to monitor programs, obtain store feedback, and assess overall implementation effectiveness.
  • Manage Accounts Payable variance processes for distribution sourced items to ensure correct prices have been invoiced.
  • Resolve store billing questions by researching discrepancies submitted at the store level with Store Billing and entering credits where appropriate or providing resolution.
  • Maintain all necessary department files and records.
  • Coordinate with Warehouse Operations to maintain the proper product flow through the facility, in a timely manner.
  • Remote access (buying system) from home or off-site location when necessary.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 plus years of Purchasing or Vendor Management experience.
  • Marketing/Logistics experience preferred or a strong understanding of store operations and merchandising methodologies and practices.
  • Understanding of beverage procurement, logistics, inventory management, marketing, accounting, and financial management practices
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills; ability to take initiative and make fact-based decisions.
  • Ability to plan and organize effectively.
  • Written and verbal communication skills as well as interpersonal skills to develop and maintain effective business relationships both internally and externally.
  • Strong computer aptitude in MS Office including Word and Excel.
  • Ability to concentrate and deal with frequent interruptions.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Lead Product Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience to architect and drive the execution of user-facing products powered by distributed cloud architectures and agentic AI systems. In this role, you will lead full-stack engineering initiatives, mentor junior/mid-level engineers, define core architectural patterns, and partner closely with product, design, and executive leadership to translate vision into production-ready systems.

Primary Responsibilities :

  • Architect, scale, and maintain full-stack systems and agentic AI applications using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern cloud infrastructure.
  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-grade agentic loops and advanced RAG pipelines for core product features.
  • Establish engineering standards, set guidelines for API middleware, and drive system performance and security best practices.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, system design sessions, and technical guidance.
  • Partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, and Leadership to translate business strategy into technical roadmaps and deliver features iteratively.

Requirements

    • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field from a Tier 1 institution.
    • Experience: 5 to 7 years of software engineering experience at a product-first technology company (high-growth startup or core Product Development org.).
    • Technical Leadership: Proven track record of technical leadership, mentoring engineers, driving architecture reviews, and owning end-to-end technical delivery.
    • Product Mindset: Deep mastery of the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC)—skilled in system trade-offs, iterative delivery, loop engineering, and using product telemetry to shape engineering decisions.
  • Full-Stack & Web Architecture :
    • Core Languages: Expertise in Python, Rust, Java, and JavaScript / TypeScript.
    • Web Engineering: Deep experience designing high-throughput RESTful/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and backend middleware architectures.
    • Architecture: Strong expertise in web protocols, low-latency API design, frontend-to-backend integration patterns, and system resilience.
  • Cloud & Distributed Infrastructure :
    • Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience architecting and deploying cloud-native applications on GCP or AWS (e.g., Lambda/Cloud Functions, Cloud Run/ECS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Pub/Sub, SQS).
    • Delivery & DevOps: Strong command of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and designing robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
  • AI Engineering & Agentic Workflows :
    • Frameworks: Production experience building complex, multi-agent workflows and LLM applications using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI.
    • AI Architecture: Advanced knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant), semantic cache, and prompt orchestration.
    • Agent Loops: Deep expertise in state machine design, memory management, tool integration, and guardrails for autonomous, self-correcting LLM agent loops.

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health Insurance
  7. Pension Plan
  8. Paid Time Off
  9. Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023.

title: Software Developer - Frontend Enterprise Web Applications Development

title: Jumbo Operator | Underground Gold Mine | 8:6 7:7 FIFO from Perth | Sandvik Fleet
description:
About Catalyst Metals

Catalyst Metals Limited owns and operates the Plutonic Gold Mine in the Eastern Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The operation is undergoing continued underground growth, with multiple mining areas progressing from development into production.

Catalyst is focused on building a long-life gold business supported by disciplined technical planning and strong operational execution.

Catalyst Metals Limited is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX code: CYL).

Catalyst Metals Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from people who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander.

About the Role

We take pride in the ground we work in – competent rock, a strong safety culture and a modern Sandvik fleet that sets you up for success. You’ll find a supportive team environment with real pathways for development, working in technically challenging conditions that build depth in your skills and exposure to precision underground mining.

As we progress toward 2.2 million tonnes per annum, development metres are critical to unlocking new mining fronts and maintaining production momentum. Our Jumbo Operators play a key role in safely delivering quality development that underpins the future of the operation.

You’ll be operating modern Sandvik development drills in competent ground conditions, working closely with technical services to execute accurate drill patterns that directly influence advance rates and ground stability.

This is a role for operators who take pride in precision, clean drilling practices and delivering metres safely and consistently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate twin-boom development jumbo to drill headings to design
  • Accurately mark-up and drill development patterns
  • Install ground support in accordance with plan
  • Conduct face inspections and hazard identification
  • Maintain drilling accuracy to support efficient charging and blasting
  • Complete pre-starts and basic machine maintenance

Requirements

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Strong commitment to safety and team-based work
  • Proven experience operating twin-boom jumbo underground

title: Job announcement for Roster - Geneticist positions
description:
CIMMYT is a cutting edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow's problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries.

For more information, visit cimmyt.org.

CIMMYT is building a Roster of qualified professionals to be considered for future opportunities in various locations and areas of expertise.

What is a Roster?

A roster is a pool of pre-assessed, qualified candidates who may be contacted when a relevant position becomes available. This approach allows us to respond more efficiently to hiring needs and significantly shorten recruitment timelines when vacancies arise.

CIMMYT has opened a call for applications for Breeders committed to implement CIMMYT's Strategy related positions such as:

  • Maize Molecular Geneticist
  • Scientist, Quantitative Genetics

Specific Duties:

  • Work with other genetics specialists to design and evaluate new and current breeding schemes through simulation, retrospective analysis, and pilot testing.
  • Develop strategy in collaboration with breeding teams and other stakeholders and support the development of plans to optimize the use of new breeding tools and methodologies.
  • Support breeding teams to ensure that target product profiles drive breeding activities and that breeding efforts are aligned to these breeding targets.
  • Support the breeding teams to set up disciplined processes to select parental germplasm in a targeted manner, as well as identify and implement ways to overcome resource, logistical, and biological constraints to shorten the breeding cycle time and increase the accuracy of data prior to selection of parents.
  • Contribute to the development of a training strategy and content to mentor and consult with breeding teams.
  • Lead and contribute to both virtual and hands-on training and mentorship activities targeted at CGIAR-NARES breeding teams in Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
  • Providing support to internal and external reviews and evaluations.
  • Contributing to publications derived from the breeding optimization project.
  • Coordinate the molecular breeding work, particularly to enhance the adaptation to the temperate environments via genetics, genomics, and molecular biology approaches.
  • Contribute to generating data on de novo genome assemblies, transcriptomes, and annotations.
  • Analyze the genomic differentiation between tropical and temperate seed for key traits of interest using genome resequencing data.
  • Genetic mapping of important traits associated with photoperiod sensitivity, and resistance/tolerance to major biotic and abiotic stresses in seeds.
  • Cloning and validation of functional genes targeting the improvement of the seed yield and stress tolerance.
  • Contribute to joint research proposals and seek opportunities for new collaborations and funding sources.
  • Manuscript writing and publication of research data in high-impact journals.

Requirements

  • PhD in plant breeding, quantitative genetics, biometrics, molecular genetics or plant biotechnology, or other highly related fields in genetics and breeding.
  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in private industry and/or an advanced modern breeding program is a plus.
  • In-depth understanding of practical breeding applications and logistical constraints that will be relevant to breeding programs targeting the developing world (i.e., CGIAR centers, national systems, and private sector organizations).
  • Expertise in statistical analysis software (R, mixed modeling, perhaps machine learning, etc.) and a creative and innovative mindset.
  • A good understanding of quantitative genetics and underlying mathematical theory.
  • Experience in plant gene discovery, cloning, and functional analysis.
  • Expertise in using statistical analysis software (R, Python, perhaps machine learning, etc.).
  • A good understanding of quantitative genetics and bioinformatics.
  • Track record of high-quality publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Good reporting and communication skills in English (working language).
  • The selected candidate must exhibit the following competencies: Problem-Solving, Client Orientation, Good Communication, Multicultural Awareness and Collaboration.

Benefits

Interested candidates may apply online

CIMMYT Talent Roster Information

Qualified candidates may be invited to join CIMMYT's talent roster for two years. You will be requested to opt in or out of having your information retained for future opportunities.

Important Note:

This announcement is not linked to a specific, currently opened position. Inclusion in the roster means you may be considered for upcoming vacancies that match your profile, but it does not guarantee employment.

CIMMYT is an equal opportunity employer. It fosters a multicultural work environment that values gender equality, teamwork, and respect for diversity. Women are encouraged to apply.

  • Able to meet respirator fit requirements, including being clean-shaven where required, and comfortable performing physical work throughout the shift, including standing for extended periods and handling materials generally between 20–50 lbs.
  • Reliable, punctual, and comfortable working independently once trained.

OUR WHY: We exist to move people. Our mission is to design, deliver, and support market-leading bus and motorcoach solutions that are safe, accessible, efficient, and reliable. Together, NFI is enabling more livable cities through connected, clean, and sustainable transportation.
