title: Mobile Maintenance Superintendent | Underground | FIFO 8:6 from Perth
description:
Mobile Maintenance Superintendent | Underground | FIFO 8:6 from Perth

About Catalyst Metals

Catalyst Metals owns and operates the Plutonic Gold Mine in the Eastern Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The Plutonic Gold Mine produces 95koz of gold annually. The Company also holds the Four Eagles Gold Project in Bendigo.

Catalyst Metals Limited is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX code: CYL).

Catalyst Metals Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from people who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander.

About the Role

If you’re a Maintenance Superintendent who values well-maintained equipment and a properly resourced workshop, this is an opportunity to join a maintenance team that’s set up to succeed. Our underground fleet includes modern Sandvik development and production rigs, load and haul units equipped with RTC systems, Normet charge rigs, Volvo ITs providing exposure to a diverse and technically advanced range of equipment.

We operate from a purpose-built six-bay steel workshop complete with overhead cranes and a service pit, supported by a dedicated maintenance store carrying more than $3 million in parts and consumables. With separate light vehicle and boilermaker facilities located nearby, we’ve invested heavily in our infrastructure so you can focus on quality maintenance and continuous improvement – not chasing parts or working around limitations.

Beyond our main operation, we also have smaller satellite sites up and running with more coming online across the belt. These present genuine opportunities to take ownership – assisting in establishing satellite workshop facilities, setting maintenance standards and defining what “good” looks like across different operating environments.

In a long-life operation with a growing footprint, this is a stable and professional environment where your trade skills won’t just be valued – they’ll help shape the way we operate.

Key Responsibilities

As our Underground Maintenance Superintendent on an 8/6 FIFO roster from Perth, you will be responsible for leading and developing the Underground Maintenance team to safely deliver reliable and efficient maintenance outcomes across the underground mobile fleet.

Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, you will provide hands on leadership, coaching and direction to maintenance supervisors and crews while building a culture focused on safety, accountability and continuous improvement.

Working closely with Underground Mining Operations and other site departments, you will ensure maintenance activities are aligned with production priorities, equipment reliability targets and business objectives. This role offers the opportunity to make a genuine impact by driving maintenance performance, improving equipment availability and contributing to the continued growth of one of Western Australia's growing underground gold operations.

Duties will include, but not limited to:

  • Lead and manage the Underground Mobile Maintenance team, including supervisors, tradespeople and apprentices, fostering a culture of safety, accountability and high performance.
  • Execute maintenance plans and schedules to maximise fleet availability, reliability and utilisation in support of production targets.
  • Provide leadership across the underground mobile fleet and site services to ensure safe and efficient mining operations.
  • Drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with WA mining legislation, company standards and underground-specific safety requirements.
  • Manage maintenance budgets, resources, contractors and OEM relationships to deliver cost-effective maintenance outcomes.
  • Oversee planned and reactive maintenance of underground mining equipment, including loaders, trucks, development and production drills, bolters and ancillary equipment.
  • Work closely with Underground Mining Operations to ensure maintenance priorities align with the mine plan and production requirements.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment performance, reduce downtime and improve maintenance efficiency.
  • Coach, mentor and develop supervisors and maintenance personnel, building capability and succession within the team.
  • Monitor equipment performance and reliability trends, implementing strategies to improve asset life and reduce damage-related costs.
  • Ensure statutory inspections, testing schedules and maintenance records are completed in accordance with legislative and company requirements.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Proven experience in a senior underground maintenance leadership role, ideally at Superintendent level
  • A minimum of 3 years' superintendent experience leading maintenance teams within an underground hard-rock mining environment
  • Trade qualification in Diesel Fitting, Mechanical Fitting, Heavy Duty Mechanics or a related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of underground mobile equipment, including loaders, trucks, production and development drills, and ancillary mining equipment.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing supervisors, tradespeople, contractors and apprentices in a production-focused environment.
  • Strong understanding of maintenance management systems, planning processes and asset reliability principles.
  • Experience managing maintenance budgets, contractor performance and OEM relationships.
  • Sound knowledge of WA mining legislation and underground mining safety requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships across site.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership and continuous improvement.
  • Strong computer literacy, including Pronto and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Current WA C Class Driver's Licence.
  • Schedule 26 Statutory Appointment or the ability to obtain one.
  • Certificate IV in Leadership & Management and Senior First Aid Certificate highly regarded.

Benefits

Why Catalyst?

FIFO isn’t for everyone — it requires commitment and time away from home. That’s why we place strong emphasis on creating a supportive team culture, approachable leadership and an environment where people work hard, back each other in, and still find time to have a laugh and enjoy what site has to offer.

We offer:

  • Family friendly 8/6 roster
  • Leadership role within a growing underground gold operation
  • Opportunity to influence maintenance strategy and equipment performance across the operation
  • Exposure to a growing and expanding underground mining business
  • Health insurance benefits
  • Supportive and collaborative site leadership team
  • Autonomy to drive improvement initiatives and implement meaningful change
  • Ongoing development and internal progression opportunities
  • The opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of the Plutonic operation and broader Catalyst business

This role offers genuine development potential for someone looking to build their career within a growing Australian mining business.

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you. Applications are currently being accepted, so apply now.

Agency referrals are not being accepted.

Farmers Insurance is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). About the Role

This role will focus on developing and implementing statistical and machine learning models to identify trends, generate insights, and support business and financial outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with the ability to translate complex data and modeling results into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.   • Prepare, structure, and analyze large datasets from internal and external sources for modeling and analytics

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of predictive modeling frameworks, processes, and best practices

  • Collaborate with other analysts, data scientists, and business partners to deliver analytical solutions

  • Master's degree is preferred
  • Strong foundation in statistics, predictive modeling, and machine learning concepts
  • Experience working with large datasets and performing data preparation, transformation, and analysis
  • Experience developing and validating predictive or statistical models
  • Programming experience in Python, R, SQL, or similar analytical languages
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong attention to data quality, model accuracy, and analytical rigor
  • Ability to work collaboratively with business, technical, and analytics teams

About Catalyst Metals

Catalyst Metals Limited owns and operates the Plutonic Gold Mine in the Eastern Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The operation is undergoing continued underground growth, with multiple mining areas progressing from development into production.

Catalyst is focused on building a long-life gold business supported by disciplined technical planning and strong operational execution.

Catalyst Metals Limited is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX code: CYL).

Catalyst Metals Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from people who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander.

We take pride in the ground we work in – competent rock, a strong safety culture and a modern Sandvik fleet that sets you up for success. You’ll find a supportive team environment with real pathways for development, working in technically challenging conditions that build depth in your skills and exposure to precision underground mining.

As we build toward 2.2 million tonnes per annum, efficient load and haul performance is central to achieving production targets. Our Bogger Operators are critical to keeping headings clean, stopes productive and ore moving safely to surface.

Operating modern Sandvik LHDs equipped with RTC systems, you’ll work across development and production areas, maintaining steady material movement and supporting cycle time optimisation.

  • Strong commitment to safety and safe work practices

  • Proven ability to work effectively within underground production environments
  • Current WA C-Class Driver's Licence

FIFO isn’t for everyone — it requires commitment and time away from home.   • Exposure to a growing and expanding underground operation
  • Opportunity to contribute beyond your core role and influence how we operate
  • Supportive and collaborative site leadership team
  • Ongoing development and internal progression opportunities

This role offers genuine development potential for someone looking to build their career within a growing Australian mining business.

title: Lead. (Associate Director), Stewardship & Donor Relations , HHHF
description:
Position Title: Lead, Stewardship & Donor Relations

Reports to: Director, Marketing & Communications

Position: Full-time, Permanent

Location: Hybrid – Humber River Health Foundation, Toronto (North York), ON (Tuesday–Thursday in office; Monday & Friday remote)

Salary: $92,029–$109,747, plus comprehensive benefits, HOOPP pension, and four weeks' vacation.

About Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation

Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation inspires philanthropy in support of Humber River Health, one of Canada's leading community hospitals. Through the generosity of donors, corporations, foundations, volunteers, and community partners, the Foundation helps fund leading-edge technology, innovative programs, capital priorities, and exceptional patient care that improve the lives of patients and families across the communities Humber River Health serves.

As the philanthropic partner of Humber River Health, the Foundation is committed to fostering meaningful donor relationships and demonstrating the lasting impact of philanthropy. Every gift helps advance exceptional healthcare and ensures patients have access to world-class care close to home.

This is an exciting time to join the Foundation. As philanthropy continues to grow, the organization is strengthening its stewardship program to create exceptional donor experiences, deepen donor engagement, and build a culture of gratitude that inspires lifelong giving.

The Role

Reporting to the Director, Marketing & Communications, the Lead, Stewardship & Donor Relations provides strategic leadership for Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation's stewardship and donor relations program. This is an exceptional opportunity for a collaborative and strategic stewardship professional who is passionate about creating meaningful donor experiences and advancing a culture of philanthropy across the organization.

Serving as the Foundation's stewardship expert, this role establishes and leads the Foundation's stewardship strategy, defines service standards and key performance indicators, and continually enhances the donor experience. Working collaboratively across Major Gifts, Annual Giving, Events, Marketing & Communications, Finance, and Hospital leadership, the Lead, Stewardship & Donor Relations ensures donors receive exceptional recognition, reporting, communications, and engagement throughout their philanthropic journey.

This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, overseeing donor acknowledgement programs, customized stewardship plans, impact reporting, recognition initiatives, donor experiences, naming opportunities, endowment reporting, and stewardship events. The successful candidate is highly organized, relationship-focused, and passionate about creating meaningful donor experiences that reflect the Foundation's commitment to excellence.

Impact Areas

Stewardship Strategy & Donor Experience

  • Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive Foundation-wide stewardship strategy aligned with fundraising priorities.
  • Establish standardized stewardship practices while delivering highly personalized donor experiences.
  • Develop stewardship plans for principal, major, annual, legacy, and endowment donors.
  • Evaluate and enhance the donor journey to improve donor satisfaction and retention.
  • Identify innovative stewardship opportunities that deepen donor engagement and inspire future giving.

Donor Recognition & Acknowledgement

  • Oversee all donor acknowledgement programs, ensuring timely, meaningful, and personalized recognition.
  • Develop customized stewardship communications, including thank-you letters, impact reports, donor updates, and recognition materials.
  • Manage donor recognition opportunities, including naming recognition, donor walls, digital recognition, and commemorative initiatives.
  • Ensure recognition activities align with donor intent, organizational policies, and gift agreements.
  • Maintain stewardship standards that reflect exceptional donor care.

Impact Reporting & Donor Communications

  • Lead the development of customized impact reports that demonstrate the measurable outcomes of donor investments.
  • Partner with clinicians, physicians, researchers, and hospital leadership to gather meaningful stories, patient outcomes, and program updates.
  • Translate complex healthcare initiatives into compelling donor-centered communications.
  • Collaborate with Marketing & Communications to develop stewardship publications, newsletters, annual reports, and donor stories.
  • Ensure donors receive regular updates that illustrate the impact of their generosity.

Donor Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Develop personalized engagement opportunities that strengthen donor relationships.
  • Coordinate donor visits, hospital tours, milestone celebrations, and recognition events.
  • Support stewardship activities for Foundation events and major fundraising initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with donors, volunteers, physicians, hospital leaders, and Foundation staff.
  • Serve as the Foundation's primary stewardship resource.

Gift Administration & Stewardship Operations

  • Develop and maintain stewardship policies, procedures, and service standards.
  • Monitor stewardship schedules to ensure the timely completion of donor acknowledgements, reporting, and recognition commitments.
  • Maintain accurate donor records and stewardship tracking within Raiser's Edge NXT.
  • Ensure compliance with donor agreements, naming policies, and CRA fundraising standards.
  • Track stewardship activities and produce reports that measure stewardship effectiveness.

Program Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate stewardship best practices across healthcare philanthropy.
  • Develop metrics to measure donor engagement, retention, and stewardship effectiveness.
  • Recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency and the donor experience.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve stewardship processes and donor communications.
  • Continuously seek innovative approaches that elevate the Foundation's stewardship program.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate across Philanthropy, Major Gifts, Annual Giving, Marketing & Communications, Events, Finance, and Hospital departments.
  • Support fundraising strategies through coordinated donor engagement activities.
  • Partner with Finance to ensure accurate gift reporting and donor fund balances.
  • Collaborate with Marketing & Communications to ensure consistent messaging and donor communications.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in fundraising, donor relations, stewardship, or philanthropy.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading donor stewardship programs.
  • Experience preparing donor reports, impact stories, and stewardship communications.
  • Experience working with donor databases, preferably Raiser's Edge NXT.
  • Experience in healthcare philanthropy is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of CRA charitable giving regulations is considered an asset.

Knowledge & Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of fundraising best practices, donor recognition, and stewardship principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Experience using Raiser's Edge NXT or a comparable donor database.
  • Ability to leverage technology and AI to enhance stewardship processes and donor communications.

Core Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Outstanding relationship-building and interpersonal skills with a donor-centred approach.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across Foundation, Hospital, and community stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • A proactive, innovative mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.

Benefits

Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation offers a competitive compensation package, including a salary range of $92,029–$109,747, commensurate with experience, comprehensive benefits, participation in the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP), four weeks' vacation, and opportunities for ongoing professional development.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Toronto, Ontario. The successful candidate will work onsite Tuesday through Thursday at Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.

Occasional evening and weekend work will be required to support donor events, stewardship initiatives, Foundation activities, and community engagement opportunities.

This role offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the Foundation's donor stewardship program during a period of organizational growth, building meaningful donor relationships that advance exceptional healthcare at Humber River Health.

As part of the selection process, candidates will be required to complete a PI (Personality Index) assessment and a Vulnerable Sector Criminal Background Check.

title: CIMMYT Adjunct Scientist Program: Dryland Crops Improvement
description:
CIMMYT is a cutting edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow's problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries. For more information, visit

This is not an employed position. It is a part-time, Adjunct Scientist affiliation with CIMMYT.

CIMMYT's Dryland Crops Program (DCP) invites highly motivated early- or mid-career NARS scientists from focus countries* to join a CIMMYT research team working on sorghum, pearl millet, finger millet, groundnut, or pigeon pea improvement in West or Eastern Africa on an Adjunct basis.

This program aims to strengthen partnerships between CIMMYT and NARS scientists while supporting the professional development of the next generation of scientists through collaborative research, networking, capacity strengthening, and joint resource mobilization, thereby contributing to a shared regional vision for dryland crop improvement.

Adjunct Scientists will focus on their area of expertise, such as crop breeding, seed systems, socioeconomics, data science, agronomy, or related disciplines. Each Adjunct Scientist will be paired with an appropriate CIMMYT Dryland Crops Program (DCP) scientist to jointly advance their respective research programs through activities such as collaborative research, proposal development, exchange visits, strategic meetings, publications, and participation in scientific conferences.

Responsibilities / Specific Duties

• Contribute to the implementation of CIMMYT research activities under the leadership of the host CIMMYT scientist.

• Facilitate collaboration by engaging the host CIMMYT scientist in relevant activities within the scientist's institutional research program.

• Contribute to teamwork in a multicultural working environment.

• Develop joint research proposals.

• Participate in scientific publications and the dissemination of research findings.

• Contribute to relevant CIMMYT strategic and technical meetings.

• Participate in exchange visits, field activities, workshops, and scientific conferences, subject to funding availability.

• Comply with CIMMYT's relevant policies and procedures.

• Contribute to technical reports from jointly implemented activities, documenting achievements and lessons learned.

• Submit an exit report using the prescribed reporting template. The report will serve as a source of feedback to support continuous improvement of the program.

Eligibility

Applicants must:

• Be active full-time employees of a National Agricultural Research Institution in one of the target countries*.

• Have institutional support and endorsement from their employer.

• Hold one of the following qualifications:

o A PhD in a relevant discipline awarded within the last 10 years, with evidence of an active research program and scientific contributions; or

o An MSc and 5-10 years of demonstrated leadership experience in agricultural research, including leading research projects, programs, or technical initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong scientific potential and a commitment to collaborative research.

• Have good written and spoken English skills.

Areas of Research

• Plant Breeding and Genetics

• Seed Systems

• Agronomy and Crop Management

• Socioeconomics and Market Systems

• Biometrics and Data Science

• Applied Genetics and Genomics

• Crop Physiology

• Crop Protection

Duration

The appointment is for one year, with the possibility of a one-year extension based on performance, mutual benefit, and funding availability.

Benefits

Adjunct Scientists remain employees of their home institutions and are not employees of CIMMYT. However, CIMMYT will provide the following benefits during the adjunct appointment:

________________________________________

Candidates must apply online. Applications must include the following documents: a Letter of Motivation, and an Institutional Endorsement Letter from the candidate's home institution.

Applications deadline: 20 September 2026

CIMMYT fosters a multicultural work environment that values gender equality, teamwork, and respect for diversity. Women are encouraged to apply.

title: Field Service Project Manager
description:
Clearsite Industrial Services is seeking a Project Manager to support our growing Industrial and Environmental Services business. This position will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing field service projects from initial scope through completion.

The Project Manager will work closely with customers, Operations, field crews, and internal teams to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage industrial and environmental service projects from planning through completion.
  • Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
  • Coordinate field crews, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and other resources.
  • Conduct site visits to evaluate project requirements and prepare for upcoming work.
  • Monitor project costs, labor hours, equipment utilization, schedules, and overall profitability.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution and address project-related concerns as they arise.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Safety to ensure projects are completed safely and efficiently while meeting customer requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with company health and safety policies, procedures, and applicable regulations throughout project execution.
  • Manage project documentation, work orders, daily reports, change orders, and project closeout.
  • Conduct field audits to verify personnel, equipment, safety documentation, and project requirements are in compliance.
  • Provide direction and support to field supervisors and crews during project execution.
  • Identify and resolve project delays, field issues, resource constraints, and other challenges that may impact project completion.
  • Provide project status updates and reports to management as needed.
  • Oversee field service and emergency response projects as assigned.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of project management experience.
  • Experience managing field-based projects, crews, equipment, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience with project estimating, job costing, and resource planning.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with customers, Operations, Safety, and leadership.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly to customer locations and active worksites as needed to oversee projects, coordinate field activities, and support project execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with industrial cleaning, tank cleaning, vacuum services, hydroblasting, environmental remediation, waste services, or emergency response.
  • OSHA, HAZWOPER, or other relevant safety certifications.
  • Experience preparing estimates, proposals, bids, and change orders.
  • Knowledge of environmental and industrial safety requirements.
  • Basic mechanical knowledge and troubleshooting experience with industrial field service equipment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional nights, weekends, extended hours, and overnight travel based on project needs.

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive base pay + project bonus

title: Telehealth Psychotherapist LPCC/LMFT/LCSW California Licensed Spanish Bilingual
description:
Clarity Squared Behavioral, Inc. is seeking a dedicated and compassionate California-Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) or Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) to join our clinical team in a remote, part-time capacity to start. As a psychotherapist, you will provide therapy via telehealth focusing on Workers Comp patients, veterans, surgical patients, seniors and others. This role offers the flexibility of working from home while making a meaningful impact in the lives of clients. The ability to go full time is available over time. Hours are flexible. We have a strong commitment to the underserved Hispanic Community and offer our services in both English and Spanish. Bilingual (Spanish-English) is a huge plus, but not a necessarily requirement for the right candidate.

You will engage with clients utilizing evidence-based therapeutic techniques, primarily Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). Your expertise will play a crucial role in helping individuals navigate their mental health challenges including depression, anxiety, trauma, OCD, PTSD, grief, loneliness and others, often to get back on the job and improve their overall well-being. Initial expectations are for 20 sessions per week, with potential for rapid growth as you become comfortable with our system. Equity participation can be earned. This is a 1099 position.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must hold a valid California LPCC, LMFT or LCSW license.
  • Experience with telehealth platforms and confidence in providing virtual therapy.
  • Strong understanding of CBT and other therapeutic modalities
  • Comfortable navigating electronic health records (EHR), specifically AthenaOne; training provided.
  • Ability to create a supportive and empathetic therapeutic environment for clients

Languages: Ability to provide therapy in Spanish is preferred, but not required.

Benefits

Highly competitive compensation. Flexible hours. Work from home/remote but fully supported. Work with a varied population. Potential for equity participation in a dynamic and fast growing practice. Highly collaborative organization that treats you like family. Excellent potential for professional development and financial growth. And an opportunity to help populations in need.

title: Vintage Cellar Hands - Vintage 2027
description:
We are seeking passionate Cellar Hands to join our team for Vintage 2027!

The Cloudy Bay story is one of adventure. After a single sip in 1983, David Hohnen was captivated by Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. In 1985 David and winemaker Kevin Judd launched Cloudy Bay with a vision for making New Zealand wines of uncompromising quality. It’s been that way ever since.

Around early February 2027, we will begin our harvest season in Blenheim, Marlborough, and finish around mid-April 2027. We have a number of fixed-term positions available and offer an engaging season with a comprehensive induction and applied technical training in a modern winemaking environment. You will gain valuable world-standard experience and widen your network of winemaking friends!

Your hours will be a minimum of 30 hours per week, guaranteed. During the harvest period, you may work shifts up to 12 hours in length, up to 6 days per week (weekends included) with a maximum of 72 hours per week during peak.

You will use your outstanding work ethic to perform diverse responsibilities across:

  • Grape receival, processing and pressing
  • Racking and tank transfers
  • Filtration
  • Red and white fermentation management
  • Barrel management

Requirements

  • Previous experience in the wine industry and proven experience as a Cellar Hand
  • High standards for health, safety, and quality
  • Solid English language skills
  • Refined & efficient work style and enthusiastic attitude
  • Effective communications skills
  • Resilience and a good sense of humour
  • The ability to lawfully work in New Zealand or obtain the right to lawfully work in New Zealand

Benefits

  • The opportunity to grow your skills and experience, and receive full in-house technical training
  • An inclusive environment and the opportunity to work with a world class team of passionate people
  • Daily continental breakfast – which consists of toast, fresh fruit & hot drinks
  • Catered meal provided when shifts are of more than 10 hours
  • Staff discount at our cellar door and restaurant
  • Work boots and other personal protection equipment as required by task
  • Transport provided to and from work during vintage
  • Be part of an array of social events throughout vintage

title: M26324 Specialist in Regenerative Agriculture and Responsible Sourcing
description:
CIMMYT is a cutting edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow's problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries.

For more information, visit cimmyt.org.

CIMMYT is looking for an outstanding, self-motivated, and result-oriented professional to lead the coordination, technical implementation, and scaling of regenerative agriculture and responsible supply projects with private sector companies across the Central, Bajío, and Western regions of Mexico. This role will drive CIMMYT’s sustainability and regenerative agriculture agenda within corn and alternative crop value chains, while strengthening rural agribusiness through improved market access, trade, and positioning across the value chain.

The position will be based in Guanajuato or Jalisco, with high availability for regional travel.

Key responsabilities:

  • Coordinate the local execution of regenerative agriculture, responsible sourcing, and sustainability projects, ensuring the planning and implementation of viable scaling strategies and routes that benefit farmers, organizations, and key stakeholders.
  • Carry out continuous monitoring of regenerative agriculture and sustainability goals and indicators, supervising the collection of critical data in the field (plot polygons, input history, land use, fertilizer and fuel management), guaranteeing the technical feasibility and scientific rigor of measurements that generate key information for corporate sustainability reports on water, carbon footprint and biodiversity.
  • Design and implement strategies to ensure the long-term permanence of farmers and stockpilers in regenerative agriculture programs through the exploration and co-design of innovative contract farming schemes, sustainability-linked bonds and financial models, digital data portfolios, and other viable and relevant incentives.
  • Lead the local governance of CIMMYT's project portfolio with the private sector, involving aggregators, producer organizations, and agribusiness representatives, devising and implementing efficient workflows that ensure smooth and transparent operation.
  • Strengthen relationships with key actors in local maize, wheat, and associated crop chains, increasing the positioning of CIMMYT-led research, regenerative agriculture, social and financial inclusion, and responsible sourcing initiatives.
  • Implement capacity building strategies for the consolidation of agribusiness, SMEs and rural enterprises, allowing these actors to optimize their organizational management processes, efficient raw material supply schemes and service provision, with business models aimed at consolidating in specialized markets that incorporate rural talent and sustainability criteria.
  • Formulate proposals, technically validate and plan sustainable trajectories of change for the development of new initiatives and projects that strengthen CIMMYT's portfolio, ensure resource mobilization and the inclusion of a diversity of rural actors, aligning corporate sustainability needs with the feasibility of their implementation.

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Agribusiness, Agricultural Economics, Sustainable Development, Environmental Sciences, or closely related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in coordinating agricultural projects, regenerative agriculture, and meeting sustainability KPIs.
  • Demonstrable experience in developing and accompanying agribusinesses in the implementation of business models, inclusive financing, contract farming models and risk management strategies.
  • Understanding inclusive financing tools and models
  • Solid understanding of agricultural value chains, agricultural policies and marketing dynamics of agricultural products in Mexico, certifications and corporate sustainability regulations.
  • Hands-on experience or technical familiarity with greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories and agricultural carbon accounting
  • Advanced level of user in the MS Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).
  • Advanced mastery of data analysis tools or geographic information systems
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish and English (fluent level of work for writing reports and communicating with international donors/partners).
  • Excellent multicultural communication and negotiation skills.
  • Orientation to results and fulfillment of strategic goals.
  • Ability to manage time and organize under strict deadlines.
  • Proactivity, critical thinking and effective problem solving in complex environments.

Benefits

CIMMYT offers an attractive remuneration package and support for continuous professional development. In addition to the provisions of the Mexican Labor Law our package of benefits includes year-end bonus (40 days), vacation premium (56%), life and medical insurance, supermarket coupons, savings fund, social Mexican benefits (IMSS, SAR / Infonavit).

Candidates must apply here

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Foreign national candidates must have legal documents to work in Mexico.

This position will remain open until filled.

CIMMYT is an equal opportunity employer. It fosters a multicultural work environment that values gender equality, teamwork, and respect for diversity.

title: Drainage Engineer
description:

title: City Cast Chicago, Executive Producer
description:

title: Director of Wholesale/Channel
description:
We are recruiting a Director of Wholesale/Channel to lead the build-out of Charterhouse's wholesale and channel-to-market capability — a genuinely new strategic direction for the business.

This is a senior, high-impact role that combines strategic leadership with hands-on sales execution. As a player-manager, you will be responsible for defining and delivering our wholesale go-to-market strategy, identifying the right product and service offerings for the channel, profiling and onboarding key partners, and building the commercial foundations that will allow Charterhouse to scale significantly through indirect routes to market.

Charterhouse already has an established — if informal — shadow channel, supplying services to a number of larger carriers, MSPs, VARs, and SIs. This role exists to formalise, accelerate, and significantly expand that footprint. You will work closely with the CTO, Operations, Marketing, Legal, and Sales Administration to build the systems, processes, and propositions needed to take this to market effectively.

Strategy & Commercial Development

• Define and own Charterhouse's wholesale and channel GTM strategy, identifying which services and solutions are appropriate for wholesale, referral, or resale models

• Work with Technology and Operations teams to develop a phased roadmap for the wholesale and channel portfolio

• Build commercial models appropriate to wholesale/referral dynamics — pricing frameworks, margin structures, and partner incentive schemes

• Engage Legal to ensure appropriate contractual and commercial foundations are in place

• Identify priorities and sequence rollout — building the initial portfolio first, with a roadmap for wider offerings to follow

Market & Partner Development

• Profile and segment the target partner market — including Comms Resellers, MSPs, Software Vendors, VARs, and SIs — identifying those with the strongest strategic alignment to Charterhouse's capabilities

• Build compelling sales propositions that leverage Charterhouse's direct-sales strengths and service delivery credentials in a channel context

• Develop and execute an outreach and engagement plan, including events, campaigns, and direct outreach, in collaboration with Marketing

• Be sensitive to areas of potential overlap with Charterhouse's direct offering, and develop clear positioning to navigate these constructively

Sales & Revenue Ownership

• Personally own and drive revenue from wholesale and channel accounts — this is a player-manager role, not a pure leadership position

• Build, manage, and grow a team of channel-facing sales resources in line with revenue growth (initial headcount light, with trajectory tied to performance)

• Manage and grow existing informal wholesale relationships, transitioning them to structured commercial partnerships

• Act as the senior commercial contact for key partner accounts, engaging confidently at C-level

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales Administration and internal systems teams to ensure wholesale is handled appropriately within existing processes and platforms

• Collaborate with Technology and Operations to ensure service delivery capabilities are commercially packaged for the channel

• Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, events, and content suited to a partner audience

• Provide regular pipeline, performance, and strategic updates to the CTO

Requirements

What You Bring

Essential

• Significant experience in a channel, wholesale, or indirect sales leadership role within UK telecoms, IT services, or managed services

• Demonstrable success in building or scaling a channel/wholesale function — from proposition development through to revenue generation

• A strong existing network within the UK channel community (Comms Resellers, MSPs, VARs, SIs, Carriers)

• Comfortable in a player-manager capacity — owning personal revenue targets alongside team leadership responsibilities

• Ability to engage confidently at C-level with partner businesses, including where there is commercial overlap with Charterhouse's direct offering

• Commercial acumen — able to build and evaluate wholesale/referral pricing structures and partner incentive models

Desirable

• Experience across multiple lines of business (UC, security, networking, cloud, mobile)

• Background working with Legal and commercial teams to build wholesale agreements and frameworks

• Experience optimising CRM and sales reporting processes for channel environments

• History of building or contributing to an events-led channel go-to-market approach

Personal Attributes

• Entrepreneurial and self-starting — comfortable building from scratch with limited structure

• Strong communicator and relationship builder, able to rapidly establish trust with senior partner contacts

• Commercially driven with a clear focus on revenue outcomes

• Collaborative by nature — effective working cross-functionally across a complex business

• Resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving, evolving environment

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to build something genuinely new — to take a business with world-class delivery capabilities and exceptional direct-sales credentials, and open up a major new indirect route to market. You will have the visibility, mandate, and backing to define how Charterhouse competes and grows through the channel for years to come.

• High visibility role with direct access to CTO and executive leadership

• A vibrant, inclusive culture where your voice matters

• Competitive salary and commission structure

• Flexible working arrangements

• Career progression opportunities as the wholesale division scales

• Commitment to sustainability and giving back to the community

Benefits

Join us, and your benefits and perks will include private healthcare, Medicash cashback, life assurance, workplace pension, cycle to work scheme, access to our employee assistance programme, savings discount, 20% EE discount that extends to your family and friends, a birthday gift voucher and day off, plus more.

title: Relationship Officer- Retail
description:
Managing relationships with premium segment clients by adhering to the highest standards of service quality, responding to their inquiries, and processing their transactions with the required speed and efficiency — all with the aim of strengthening the relationship with them and attracting new clients from this segment. Additionally, promoting the bank's services and products, including new offerings, and explaining them in a clear, accurate, and professional manner in order to increase the bank’s sales and achieve the desired objectives.

Requirements

University degree in administrative sciences, banking, or any related field.

Practical experience of no less than 3 years in sales management and customer service.

Practical experience with CRM-CX systems.

Knowledge of the English language.

Thorough knowledge of the bank’s services, products, and approved programs.

Good knowledge of policies and procedures governing work and their updates (both internal and external).

Proficiency in using computers and working with various applied systems.

Skills in direct selling, cross-selling, and relationship management.

Time management skills.

Analytical skills.

Ability to negotiate and persuade.

Ability to motivate and work in a team spirit.

Politeness and good manners.

Ability to understand clients’ needs.

Ability to plan, implement, and manage educational workshops related to sales and services.

Ability to handle and resolve customer complaints within authorized limits.

Verbal communication skills and the ability to interact with others (internal and external clients).

Ability to handle work pressure.

Responsibilities:

  1. Welcomes premium clients, understands their requests and needs for the bank’s services and products, and works to fulfill them efficiently with the highest levels of service within defined standards. Responds to their inquiries in a way that reflects positively on the bank and ensures building good, long-term relationships to guarantee their ongoing business with the bank.
  2. Markets all the bank’s services and products, including new ones, to premium clients and explains them clearly, professionally, and accurately to increase the bank’s sales of these services and products and achieve objectives.
  3. Implements the external and internal sales plan to acquire new clients in the premium segment. Conducts regular field visits to current and targeted clients to open new communication channels and attract a new client base, contributing to the growth of the bank’s portfolio in both assets and liabilities.
  4. Studies credit facility requests submitted by portfolio clients, verifies completeness of data and necessary information, ensures compliance with conditions and approved credit policy, checks completeness of documents, records recommendations, and forwards them to the direct supervisor.
  5. Manages relationships with premium clients within the portfolio and works on developing and providing high-quality service through various bank service channels, including cross-selling and after-sales services. Receives requests (including client requests) through the CRM-CX system or related forms for:
    • Opening new and additional accounts and related tasks and modifications, including linked accounts.
    • Requests for issuing balance certificates, interest, and commissions.
    • Requests for subscription, rental, renewal, and cancellation of safety deposit boxes.
    • Requests for credit cards, Visa Electron, prepaid cards, and electronic services.
    • Requests for opening, renewing, and canceling deposits and certificates of deposit on the banking system.
    • Requests for standing orders and instructions.
    • Requests for transfers between accounts.
    • Requests for personal loans (personal advances, car financing, housing loans).
    • Requests for power of attorney.
    • Requests for special conditions.
    • Receives checkbook requests and inputs them into the automated system.
    • Issues and executes transfers on the automated system.
    • Updates premium clients’ data.
  6. Follows up on the execution of premium segment transactions by the relevant departments, ensures completion of all documents and rectification of transaction errors, reviews pending (unexecuted) transactions, and identifies reasons for non-execution to ensure processing and protect the bank’s rights.
  7. Collects various information about premium clients and updates their data in coordination with relevant departments to maintain accurate and up-to-date information for communication and to identify potential sales opportunities.
  8. Monitors and promotes premium client services and encourages clients to develop their relationship with the bank to increase profitability for this segment.
  9. Handles telephone and verbal inquiries from premium clients and provides solutions to problems that may arise during transaction processing as quickly as possible to facilitate service delivery. Follows up on any feedback or suggestions from clients and takes them into consideration to strengthen relationships.
  10. Ensures compliance with audit, regulatory, and anti-money laundering requirements, conducts “Know Your Customer” reviews, and assesses risks related to onboarding new clients.
  11. Works closely with branch/area managers and the segment development unit to build a selected premium client base, ensuring increased bank profitability and achievement of required performance indicators.
  12. Proposes, in coordination with relevant parties, modifications to bank products and services and contributes to proposing new competitive products based on feedback received from clients of various targeted products.

title: Founding Growth Lead
description:
Clients Blackbox is a specialized Meta advertising agency that works exclusively with Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and independent financial advisory firms. We build and manage Facebook advertising funnels that generate qualified, booked appointments for our clients. We serve one vertical and we do it at a level no generalist agency can match.

Clients Blackbox is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

  5. Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) including pipeline management, deal tracking, and reporting
  6. Comfortable operating as a sole contributor across both sales and marketing functions
  7. Strong written and verbal communication skills
  8. Based in the United States and available during standard business hours
  9. Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

Benefits

  1. $85,000 base salary plus performance based commission (OTE approximately $150,000)
  1. Fully remote position
  2. Opportunity to build and lead a sales and marketing team as the company grows
  3. Work directly with the CEO and founding team
  4. Focused, single vertical niche with strong product market fit

title: Crane Operator
description:
To operate Company crane for truss setting in residential construction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Follow all company rules and guidelines in regards to procedures and safety
  • Arrive to work on time
  • Operates boom crane with standard boom lengths and angles for loads well within the lifting capacity of the crane.
  • Loads roofing material. Observes load hookup and determines safety of the load. Manipulates or depresses crane controls, such as pedals, levers, and buttons, to regulate speed and direction of crane and hoist movement according to written, verbal, or signal instructions.

Hours: 7:00 am to 3:30 pm

Monday-Saturday

Please send in your resume along with references in order to be considered for this position.

  • 1+ years’ experience in truck driving

title: AML & KYC Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The AML & KYC Analyst will support the day-to-day operation of the Group’s Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) framework. The role will focus primarily on customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, transaction monitoring, ongoing client reviews, and the maintenance of accurate AML/KYC records.

The successful candidate will have approximately 1–3 years of relevant AML/KYC or financial crime experience and will work closely with the MLRO, Compliance team, and relevant business and operational functions across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Due Diligence and Ongoing Monitoring

  • Perform Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.
  • Review customer identification and verification documentation, beneficial ownership and control structures, Source of Funds (SoF), Source of Wealth (SoW), and other relevant KYC information.
  • Carry out customer risk assessments and ensure risk ratings are appropriately documented and supported.
  • Conduct periodic and event-driven reviews of existing customers and ensure records remain complete, accurate, and up to date.
  • Conduct or support PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening and review potential matches in accordance with internal procedures.
  • Identify and escalate AML/CFT risks, inconsistencies, and red flags to the MLRO or senior Compliance personnel as appropriate.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

  • Conduct transaction monitoring reviews and investigate unusual or potentially suspicious customer activity.
  • Analyse transactional activity against expected customer behaviour, customer profiles, and identified risk factors.
  • Gather and assess relevant information to support transaction monitoring investigations.
  • Prepare clear and concise transaction monitoring review reports, documenting findings, rationale, and recommended next steps.

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. About the Role:

At CDC, our Critical Environment Technicians work hands-on in live data centres, supporting the day-to-day operation of mission critical infrastructure. This is a site-based role focused on planned works, maintenance, site logistics, and overall reliability during business hours.

You’ll play a key role in delivering technical facilities management — coordinating maintenance, managing site operations, and responding to incidents to keep our environments safe, secure, and always on.

If you’ve worked in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, much of this will feel familiar. The difference is the scale, the environment, and the opportunity to step into a stable, high-growth industry.

You’ll be part of CDC’s Operations team — on the ground every day, working closely together to deliver a strong customer experience and keep our facilities running at their best.

title: Cybersecurity Manager
description:
CIMMYT is a cutting-edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow’s problems today.   • Support internal audit, external audit and donor due diligence.
  • Manage security suppliers and licences and renewals.
  • Coordinate security standards and support with regional IT specialists across country offices, and run the organization-wide security awareness programme.
  • Report monthly on security posture, risk and control performance through agreed metrics.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Security or a related field. A master's degree is an advantage.
  • A security certification is required: CISSP, CISM, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or equivalent. Technical platform certifications are an advantage
  • +8 years of professional experience in information security, of which at least three years managing or supervising a technical team.
  • Practical experience implementing and operating an ISO/IEC 27001 management system, including Annex A control mapping, Statement of Applicability, and the production of audit evidence.
  • Experience managing security vendors, contracts, licences and budgets.
  • Experience in a multi-country or distributed organization is an advantage; experience in international research, development or non-profit organizations is a further advantage.

CIMMYT offers an attractive remuneration package and support for continuous professional development. In addition to the provisions of the Mexican Labor Law our package of benefits includes year-end bonus (40 days), vacation premium (56%), life and medical insurance, supermarket coupons, savings fund, social Mexican benefits (IMSS, SAR / Infonavit).

title: Controller
description:
About Aviture

Aviture is a software engineering and consulting firm headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. We design, build, and modernize systems for government and commercial organizations where reliability, security, and mission outcomes matter. Our work has supported wildfire and flood response, secured national events, powered augmented reality surgical training, and improved care in hospitals and senior living communities. We are a team of roughly 80 engineers, designers, and inventors who believe technology only matters if it solves a real problem.

We are also an AI-forward company. Our engineering teams use AI-accelerated development practices every day, and we expect the same mindset in our business operations. If you are already using tools like Claude to automate reporting and close tasks, you will fit right in. If you are curious but have not started, we will get you there fast.

How We Work

Our values are simple and we actually use them: embody integrity, seek ownership, stay hungry, remain grounded, create impact, and challenge with respect. This role is based in our Omaha office alongside the leadership team. We are a company of builders, and the finance seat is no exception.

The Role

This is a whole-function ownership role. You will run accounting and finance operations for the company end to end, report directly to the CEO, and sit close to the decisions your numbers inform. Aviture operates a mix of government contracts (cost reimbursable, T&M, and fixed price) and commercial engagements, so the role rewards someone who is fluent in government contract accounting and compliance but wants broader exposure than a large prime can offer.

You will inherit clean books, established systems (Procas and Paycor), and strong external partners for tax and audit. What we want you to add is forward visibility: sharper forecasting, project-level profitability insight, pricing support on new business, and automation that makes the close faster every quarter.

What You Will Own

• Accounting operations. Monthly close, general ledger, financial statements, and bank reconciliations, with a bias toward shortening the close through automation.

• Billing and revenue. Invoicing and collections across roughly ten active programs, many with multiple projects under one customer, spanning ACH and check receipts. Contract and modification setup in the accounting system and maintenance of the billing projection model.

• Project accounting. Project setup, cost tracking, profitability analysis by program, and margin reporting that tells leadership what is about to happen, not just what did.

• Budgeting and forecasting. Annual budget, rolling forecasts, cash management, and scenario analysis tied to backlog, re-competes, and pipeline.

• Pricing and deal support. Rate structures, pricing input on proposals and fixed price bids, and financial support to the sales and capture teams during contract negotiation.

title: QA/QC Manager - Modular Services
description:

The Role

A key priority will be the selection, implementation, and administration of a company-wide QMS platform, ensuring robust control of processes, documentation, audits, corrective actions, and compliance activities.

You will work closely with Engineering, Production, Projects, HSE, Procurement,Compliance and Supply Chain teams to drive quality excellence and support business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management Systems & Compliance

  • Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of the company's Quality Management System (QMS).

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

title: Senior / Staff Scientist, Assay Automation
description:
About Clear Labs

Clear Labs (CL) harnesses the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS) to simplify complex diagnostics for clinical and applied markets. By creating a fully automated platform that brings together DNA sequencing, robotics, and cloud-based analytics, Clear Labs democratizes genomics applications to deliver better clarity. Clear Labs’ turnkey platform accelerates outcomes and improves accuracy from food-borne pathogens to infectious diseases.

Position Summary

You will own the end-to-end performance of NGS assays running on Hamilton Platforms for Illumina-based sequencing assays, from wet lab execution through data interpretation. The work directly determines assay reliability in clinical use and is foundational to scaling our diagnostic platform.

This role is leveled Senior or Staff based on demonstrated scope, autonomy, and track record of shipping NGS assays into regulated environments. We will calibrate level during the interview process.

This is a hands-on role, not a managerial one. It is best suited for scientists who have repeatedly debugged failed NGS experiments and can trace issues across assay design, automated execution, and downstream data.

How This Role Operates

  • Partners daily with Assay Development, Automation Engineering, Bioinformatics, Manufacturing, and Regulatory / Quality.
  • Owns assay performance decisions on assigned product workstreams; signs off on experimental designs, root-cause findings, and verification study conclusions within scope.
  • Expected to escalate cross-functional tradeoffs and regulatory implications to the Director of Assay Development.

Location: San Carlos, CA

Primary Responsibilities

Assay Development (Core)

  • Troubleshoot and optimize full NGS workflows: extraction, fragmentation, end repair, ligation, library prep, target enrichment or amplification, pooling, and sequencing.
  • Identify root causes of assay failures and implement durable, documented fixes.
  • Redesign assay components for robustness, scalability, and reproducibility under production conditions.
  • Lead verification, characterization, and reagent qualification studies that drive assay decisions.
  • Own measurable improvements in assay reliability, variability, and yield on assigned workstreams.

Data Analysis and Experimental Design

  • Analyze sequencing data and run metrics to diagnose performance issues across the wet-to-dry interface.
  • Design experiments using DOE, regression, and hypothesis testing; quantify variance contributions.
  • Build and maintain quantitative performance metrics that characterize assay variability and stability.
  • Conduct reagent stability studies and lot-to-lot qualification.

Automation Integration

  • Develop and troubleshoot assays running on liquid handling automation (Hamilton or equivalent).
  • Partner with automation engineers to translate manual protocols into validated automated workflows.
  • Diagnose and resolve automation-related sources of variability.

Regulatory and Quality

  • Execute work under design controls and a quality management system (ISO 13485 or equivalent).
  • Contribute to analytical validation activities (LoD, precision, specificity, reproducibility, interference).
  • Apply structured problem-solving tools (FMEA, CAPA, change control) as part of routine work.

Requirements

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis; no visa sponsorship is available for this position.

  • PhD in molecular biology, genomics, bioengineering, or related field, OR equivalent industry experience defined as 8+ years in NGS assay development with at least one shipped IVD, LDT, or commercially deployed assay.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing Illumina NGS assays through to production or clinical use.
  • Track record of leading end-to-end root-cause investigations of complex assay failures.
  • Hands-on experience developing or troubleshooting assays on liquid handling automation (Hamilton or equivalent).
  • Experience working under ISO 13485, FDA design controls, or a comparable regulated quality system.
  • Working proficiency in R, Python, JMP, or equivalent for sequencing data analysis and statistical experimental design (DOE, ANOVA, regression, variance decomposition).

Preferred Experience

  • IVD or LDT assay development for oncology, infectious disease, or similar clinical indications.
  • Hands-on experience with FFPE and/or cfDNA sample types.
  • Experience with hybrid capture target enrichment and/or amplicon-based panel design.
  • Named contribution to a 510(k), De Novo, PMA, or equivalent regulatory submission.
  • Experience integrating assays with downstream bioinformatics pipelines.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

How We Will Evaluate Candidates

  • Technical depth interview: walk through a real NGS assay failure you debugged end-to-end, including the data you used to localize the root cause.
  • Experimental design exercise: design a study to characterize a defined source of variability under stated constraints.
  • Cross-functional simulation: navigate a tradeoff between assay performance, automation feasibility, and regulatory impact.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $120,000–$150,000
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-Sponsored Basic Life/AD&D, Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Stock Option Plan
  • Lunch stipend for days at headquarters

title: FIFO Scheduling Engineer - Technical Services
description:
About Catalyst Metals

Catalyst Metals Limited owns and operates the Plutonic Gold Mine in the Eastern Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The operation is undergoing continued underground growth, with multiple mining areas progressing from development into production.

Catalyst is focused on building a long-life gold business supported by disciplined technical planning and strong operational execution.

Catalyst Metals Limited is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX code: CYL).

Catalyst Metals Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from people who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander.

About the Role

At Catalyst, you won’t just take on a role – you’ll take on a challenge. Our underground operation is technically complex and continually evolving, requiring sharp thinking, collaboration and a proactive approach to problem solving.

From remnant extraction to new mining areas coming online, the work here will stretch your capability and keep you engaged. This role sits within our Technical Services team and plays a key part in delivering safe, practical and production-aligned engineering outcomes underground.

You’ll work closely with geology, underground operations and maintenance to ensure plans are executable, risks are understood and performance is optimised. With multiple growth fronts across the mine, this is a dynamic environment where engineering decisions have a direct and visible impact.

You’ll be supported by experienced leaders who are genuinely invested in mentoring and developing their teams. We believe in building capability from within, and as our operations expand across the belt, so do the opportunities to broaden your exposure and progress your career.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise or step into broader operational responsibilities over time, this is a genuine opportunity to grow while helping shape the future direction of the mine.

Key Responsibilities

As our Scheduling Engineer, you will be a key member of the Technical Services team, responsible for developing and maintaining monthly 3-Month Schedules (3MS) that guide underground mining activities and support the achievement of production, safety and business objectives.

Reporting to the Senior Planning Engineer, you will work closely with Underground Operations, Geology and other technical disciplines to ensure mine plans are practical, achievable and aligned with operational priorities, while driving continuous improvement across planning and scheduling processes.

This is a newly created role that offers the opportunity to directly influence production outcomes across a growing underground business. The position is offered on an 8 days on, 6 days off FIFO roster, providing a strong work-life balance while remaining closely connected to site operations and decision-making. As the operation continues to grow and mature, the role is planned to transition to an attractive 4 days on, 3 days off FIFO roster, offering even greater flexibility and lifestyle benefits, subject to operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain monthly 3-Month Schedules (3MS) for underground mining operations
  • Track planning and scheduling performance to ensure production targets are achieved safely and efficiently
  • Plan underground infrastructure and support associated project activities
  • Work closely with Underground Operations to coordinate and schedule mining activities
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to Short-Term Planning Engineers
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives within planning and scheduling systems and processes
  • Collaborate with Geology, Technical Services, Maintenance and other support functions to optimise resource utilisation
  • Monitor plan compliance and alignment with weekly and operational schedules

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Mining Engineering or relevant discipline
  • Current Western Australian C Class Driver's Licence
  • Experience in underground mine planning and/or scheduling preferably gold
  • Strong competency in Deswik CAD (Spatial), Deswik Scheduler and Deswik Ops
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • A solid understanding of underground mining methods and scheduling principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail
  • The ability to anticipate operational challenges and develop practical solutions
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • The ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines
  • A collaborative approach and commitment to continuous improvement

Benefits

Why Catalyst?

FIFO isn’t for everyone — it requires commitment and time away from home. That’s why we place strong emphasis on creating a supportive team culture, approachable leadership and an environment where people work hard, back each other in, and still find time to have a laugh and enjoy what site has to offer.

We offer:

  • Lifestyle friendly roster promoting genuine work-life balance
  • Health insurance benefits
  • Exposure to a growing and expanding underground operation
  • Opportunity to play a key role in production planning and business performance
  • Strong mentorship from experienced engineering and operational leaders
  • Supportive and collaborative site leadership team
  • Ongoing development and internal progression opportunities
  • The opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of the Plutonic operation and broader Catalyst business

This role offers genuine development potential for someone looking to build their career within a growing Australian mining business.

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you. Applications are currently being accepted, so apply now.

Agency referrals are not being accepted.

title: Product Engineer
description:

title: Founder (CEO) - AI Catalyst Discovery Venture
description:
Who We Are

ATUM is a Singapore deep-tech venture builder and investor. We build companies from breakthrough, IP-backed research, bringing capital, operational muscle, and partners from industry, VC, and government into every build. We've built and backed 15 ventures, and we invest in fast-scaling deep-tech with real fundamentals, not hype.

The Venture

Catalysts sit at the heart of the chemical and energy economy, behind the fuels, materials, and chemicals the world runs on, yet they're still discovered the way they were decades ago: slow, expensive, trial-and-error lab work that can take years and millions to find a single new catalyst.

We're building the company to change that.

The core is an AI-driven catalyst discovery platform, developed at A*STAR, that combines computational simulation, machine learning, and automated experimental validation into a single closed loop, discovering and validating novel, high-performance catalysts in a fraction of the time and cost of traditional R&D.

The technology is real and proven on live industrial problems, backed by a proprietary experimental dataset and a rare combination of deep chemistry and AI expertise that a competitor cannot simply hire its way into. The first markets are in sustainable and green chemicals, converting CO2 into valuable products like methanol and fuels, and improving catalytic processes across the chemicals and energy industries.

This is a platform-led deep-tech company in a vast, defensible market at the centre of the energy transition. It's a long game with a real head start and a clear path to category leadership.

The Role

You'll be the founding CEO. You'll own commercial strategy, go-to-market, fundraising, and building the company from zero, alongside two strong technical co-founders, a dedicated ATUM venture team, and the inventors.

Together, we'll:

  • Validate the beachhead and convert early industry interest into commercial pilots and LOIs
  • Shape the business model and pricing
  • Raise pre-seed and seed capital, and build the founding team
  • Take the platform from validated technology to deployed, revenue-generating systems

This is not a job. It's a founding journey where you share the risk, the upside, and the impact.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • Industry insider: You have built, or sold, or scaled in chemicals, petrochemicals, specialty chemicals, or industrial energy. And you know how these buyers actually make decisions.
  • Field-tested seller: You have sold complex, technical solutions into industrial customers across many accounts, not managed a single relationship from inside one company. You turn real-world process pain into commercial traction.
  • Commercially sharp: You think in unit economics, sales cycles, and business models, and you can lead a technical team without deferring to them.
  • A builder, not a passenger: You self-start, run at ambiguity, and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Resilient & ready: You have the runway to commit full-time, and you know building deep tech in a conservative industry takes grit and patience.

Benefits

Why Build With Us

  • A validated starting point: Real technology, real industry pull, real expertise, not a blank page.
  • Founder-led: You're the CEO, with meaningful founding equity.
  • Funding-ready: ATUM backs the build with pre-seed capital and grant access, plus follow-on funding from our investor network.
  • Hands-on partners: We're in the trenches with you on product, GTM, and fundraising, not just on the cap table.
  • Domain access: Labs, technical experts, early adopters, and an ecosystem already engaged.
